categories.label: Administrative Essentials
categories.description: Residence registration, tax, ID, bank, mobile

resources.title: Darwin — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of AUD 2,500 per month for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Darwin. Northern Territory guidance caps the security deposit at four weeks' rent, represented here as 1 month: https://nt.gov.au/property/private-renters/find-out-about-rental-costs/security-deposits-bonds. Domain provides Darwin City rental listings: https://www.domain.com.au/rent/darwin-city-nt-0800/.

resources.title: Darwin — Banking
resources.body: CommBank's migrant account page requires a current passport, entry-visa information, foreign tax-residency TINs, and an Australian residential address for full access after in-branch identification: https://www.commbank.com.au/moving-to-australia/banking.html. Westpac's official new-arrivals page supports Westpac as a newcomer option and asks for a mobile number, email, arrival date, Australian address, foreign tax number, and valid ID for activation: https://www.westpac.com.au/international-travel/new-to-australia/choice-new-arrivals/.

resources.title: Darwin — Schools
resources.body: Good Shepherd Lutheran College in the Darwin area states that it is an IB World School offering the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme: https://goodshepherd.nt.edu.au/our-schools. The Northern Territory Government's Darwin-region list links to the official education directory for government and non-government schools: https://nt.gov.au/learning/primary-and-secondary-students/list-of-urban-and-remote-schools.

resources.title: Darwin — Arrival registration
resources.body: On arrival, travellers must show a valid passport or travel document and complete and show an Incoming Passenger Card; the card requirement applies to most passengers, subject to prescribed exemptions: https://www.abf.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/crossing-the-border/at-the-border/incoming-passenger-card-(ipc).

resources.title: Darwin — Tax ID
resources.body: The Australian tax identifier is the Tax File Number (TFN). A permanent migrant or temporary visitor who is in Australia with a valid work-rights visa linked to their passport or travel document can apply online through Individual Auto-Registration; the ATO specifies alternative resident or paper routes when IAR is unavailable: https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/tax-file-number/apply-for-a-tfn/foreign-passport-holders-permanent-migrants-and-temporary-visitors-tfn-application.

resources.title: Darwin — Transport
resources.body: CDC Northern Territory operates public bus services in Darwin, Palmerston and rural areas for the Northern Territory Government: https://cdcnorthernterritory.com.au/travel-info/timetables-and-maps/. NT Government says Greater Darwin public buses are currently free, so no monthly-pass fare is published: https://nt.gov.au/driving/public-transport-cycling/public-buses/fares. New NT residents must transfer an overseas licence within 3 months; recognised-country licences can transfer without theory and practical tests, while others must complete those tests: https://nt.gov.au/driving/licence/new-nt-residents-and-visitors/transfer-your-overseas-licence. Eligible Australian permanent residents can enrol in Medicare online through myGov or with the enrolment form and need to live in Australia, hold a current passport or ImmiCard, and have valid Home Affairs visa details: https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/enrolling-medicare-if-youre-australian-permanent-resident?context=60092.

resources.title: Geelong — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo lists a one-bedroom apartment in Geelong city centre at AUD 1,850 per month: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Geelong. In Victoria, the usual maximum bond is one month's rent unless weekly rent exceeds AUD 900 or VCAT sets a higher amount: https://www.consumer.vic.gov.au/housing/renting/rent-bond-bills-and-condition-reports/bond/bond-amounts-and-paying-a-bond. The main national rental portal's Geelong search is https://www.realestate.com.au/rent/in-geelong,+vic+3220/list-1.

resources.title: Geelong — Banking
resources.body: CommBank's official newcomer page says applicants show a current original passport in branch, bring each foreign-residency TIN, and provide an Australian residential address for full access.

resources.title: Geelong — Schools
resources.body: Kardinia International College in Geelong is an IB World School offering the Primary Years Programme and Diploma Programme: https://www.kardinia.vic.edu.au/about. IB Schools Australasia provides the regional school directory: https://ibaustralasia.org/schools/.

resources.title: Geelong — Arrival registration
resources.body: Most arriving passengers must complete and present an Incoming Passenger Card to Australian Border Force, including their intended Australian address and local contact details.

resources.title: Geelong — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign-passport holder who is in Australia with a valid work-rights visa can apply free online for a Tax File Number through the ATO Individual Auto-Registration system.

resources.title: Geelong — Transport
resources.body: Transport Victoria coordinates the public network; Geelong local buses use myki. McHarry's lists the 2026 one-zone full-fare monthly myki pass at AUD 118.60: https://mcharrys.com.au/travel-information/fare-information/. A person living in Victoria for more than six months must convert a valid overseas licence; recognized jurisdictions may avoid tests, while others require them: https://www.vicroads.vic.gov.au/licences/convert-your-licence/convert-overseas-licence. Eligible permanent residents can enrol in Medicare through myGov or with form MS004 and supporting identity/residency documents: https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/enrolling-medicare-if-youre-australian-permanent-resident?context=60092.

resources.title: Sunshine Coast — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reported A$1,687.50 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (updated 19 June 2026): https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Sunshine-Coast . Queensland's RTA caps a general-tenancy rental bond at four weeks' rent (represented as 1 month): https://www.rta.qld.gov.au/starting-a-tenancy/rental-bond . realestate.com.au lists Sunshine Coast rental properties: https://about.realestate.com.au/sitemap/queensland/

resources.title: Sunshine Coast — Banking
resources.body: ANZ says newcomers need key ID such as a passport, an Australian residential address, an Australian mobile number and a tax identification number or equivalent: https://www.anz.com.au/personal/bank-accounts/everyday-accounts/migrant-banking/ . CommBank requires an original current passport and foreign-tax-residency TINs, followed by branch identity verification after arrival: https://www.commbank.com.au/moving-to-australia/banking.html

resources.title: Sunshine Coast — Schools
resources.body: Matthew Flinders Anglican College in Buderim states that its Advanced Mathematics pathway includes preparation for Cambridge IGCSE examinations: https://www.mfac.edu.au/prospectus/welcome-to-our-school/ . The Queensland Department of Education Schools Directory can be searched by school name or suburb: https://schoolsdirectory.eq.edu.au/

resources.title: Sunshine Coast — Arrival registration
resources.body: Sunshine Coast arrivals enter Australia through Sunshine Coast Airport or Brisbane Airport, where under Australian law most passengers must identify themselves and complete an Incoming Passenger Card (IPC); the Australian Border Force provides the card on board or in the arrival terminal, it must be completed in English, and prescribed exemptions apply: https://www.abf.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/crossing-the-border/at-the-border/incoming-passenger-card-(ipc)

resources.title: Sunshine Coast — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign-passport holder who is in Australia with a valid work-rights visa can apply free online for a Tax File Number through the ATO Individual Auto-Registration system: https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/tax-file-number/apply-for-a-tfn/foreign-passport-holders-permanent-migrants-and-temporary-visitors-tfn-application

resources.title: Sunshine Coast — Transport
resources.body: Translink is the Sunshine Coast public-transport network; fares are A$0.50 per journey and a visitor go explore card provides unlimited Sunshine Coast bus travel for A$1.50 per day, but no monthly-pass price was published: https://translink.com.au/travel-with-us/around-queensland/sunshine-coast . Resident-visa holders must transfer to a Queensland licence after living in Queensland for 3 months; requirements depend on the issuing country and may include tests: https://www.qld.gov.au/transport/licensing/driver-licensing/overseas/transfer . Eligible residents can enrol in Medicare online through myGov or with a Medicare enrolment form, using a current passport or ImmiCard and valid Home Affairs visa details: https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/enrolling-medicare?context=60092

resources.title: Wollongong — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's July 2026 Wollongong data reports AUD 1,430 per month for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment; NSW caps a rental bond at four weeks' rent, represented as one month here; realestate.com.au is Australia's leading property resource and provides a Wollongong rental search.

resources.title: Wollongong — Banking
resources.body: Newcomer options supported by official bank pages include CommBank and ANZ Plus. ANZ Plus requires a passport, selfie, Australian mobile number and Australian residential address; CommBank's arrival setup requires its welcome letter, the first two pages of the Visa Grant notice, the original current passport and foreign tax-residency TINs.

resources.title: Wollongong — Schools
resources.body: The Illawarra Grammar School in the Wollongong region offers invitation-only Cambridge IGCSE Co-ordinated Sciences and Global Perspectives; the NSW Public School Finder is the official directory for local and nearby public schools.

resources.title: Wollongong — Arrival registration
resources.body: Most passengers entering Australia must complete and present an Incoming Passenger Card, including their intended Australian address; the responsible authority is the Australian Border Force.

resources.title: Wollongong — Tax ID
resources.body: A permanent migrant or temporary visitor who is in Australia and holds a valid work-rights visa can apply free online for a Tax File Number through the Australian Taxation Office's Individual Auto-Registration system.

resources.title: Wollongong — Transport
resources.body: Wollongong is in the Illawarra Opal network. No monthly pass is published; adult pay-as-you-go travel is capped at AUD 50 per week. Australian citizens, permanent residents and New Zealand licence holders must transfer an overseas licence within three months; temporary overseas visitors arriving after 1 July 2023 may use an overseas licence for up to six months. Eligible permanent residents can enrol in Medicare online through myGov or with a Medicare enrolment form.

resources.title: Antwerp — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's 1 August 2026 city table reports EUR 920.36 for a one-bedroom apartment in Antwerp city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/prices_by_city.jsp?displayCurrency=EUR&itemId=26). The Vlaams Woninghuurdecreet of 9 November 2018 sets the rental guarantee for dwellings in the Flemish Region (which includes Antwerp) at a maximum of three months' rent, in force since 1 January 2019 (https://codex.vlaanderen.be/PrintDocument.ashx?id=1029963&datum=&geannoteerd=false&print=false). Immoweb has a dedicated Antwerp apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/antwerp/2000).

resources.title: Antwerp — Banking
resources.body: KBC's official expat account page says people settling in Flanders should use KBC and that applicants arriving in Belgium must bring an ID card and residence permit to the branch to sign for and collect the debit card (https://www.kbcbrussels.be/retail/en/products/payments/current-accounts/open-plus-account-for-expats.html).

resources.title: Antwerp — Schools
resources.body: Antwerp International School offers the International Baccalaureate PYP, MYP and DP (https://ais-antwerp.be/learning/curriculum/). Owl Academy in Antwerp teaches the British National Curriculum (https://owl-academy.com/curricula/elementary-school/). The University of Antwerp's schools page lists Antwerp international schools and links to the city's school finder (https://www.uantwerpen.be/en/jobs/international-staff-office/preparation/family-matters/schools/).

resources.title: Antwerp — Arrival registration
resources.body: Antwerp's official page says its Loket Migratie helps newcomers register their stay and works by appointment (https://www.antwerpen.be/registratie-en-verblijf-niet-belg).

resources.title: Antwerp — Tax ID
resources.body: Belgium uses the National Register Number, or BIS Register Number where applicable, as the relevant individual identifier. The National Register number is assigned automatically when a person's base record is entered (https://www.ibz.rrn.fgov.be/sites/default/files/documents/nl/rijksregister/onderrichtingen/IT-lijst/IT000_Rijksregisternummer.pdf). For an eligible foreign person using ForReg who has neither number, the FPS Finance processing officer creates one (https://finance.belgium.be/sites/default/files/E-services/FORREG/FORREG_Userguide_EN_V1.pdf); ForReg eligibility and steps are described at https://finance.belgium.be/en/E-services/forreg.

resources.title: Antwerp — Transport
resources.body: An Antwerp city decision identifies De Lijn as the Flemish public-transport operator serving Antwerp (https://ebesluit.antwerpen.be/zittingen/23.0926.3894.4548/agendapunten/24.0729.9975.6708). De Lijn's adult Omnipas costs EUR 62 for one month, plus a EUR 10 MOBIB-card administration fee (https://www.delijn.be/en/content/vervoerbewijzen/abonnementen/omnipas/).

resources.title: Antwerp — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Join a Belgian health-insurance fund (ziekenfonds/mutuality) or the public HZIV; membership is required for compulsory-insurance healthcare benefits (https://www.riziv.fgov.be/nl/thema-s/verzorging-kosten-en-terugbetaling/verzekerbaarheid/aansluiten-bij-een-ziekenfonds).

resources.title: Bruges — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's June 2026 Brugge table reports EUR 825.00 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre, last updated 19 June 2026 (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Brugge). The Vlaams Woninghuurdecreet of 9 November 2018 caps the rental guarantee for dwellings in the Flemish Region (which includes Bruges) at a maximum of three months' rent, in force since 1 January 2019 (https://codex.vlaanderen.be/PrintDocument.ashx?id=1029963&datum=&geannoteerd=false&print=false). Immoweb has a dedicated Bruges (postcode 8000) apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/bruges/8000).

resources.title: Bruges — Banking
resources.body: KBC allows applicants without Belgian citizenship or a permanent Belgian address to apply online from abroad; after arrival, they must visit a branch with an ID card and residence permit to sign for and collect the debit card.

resources.title: Bruges — Schools
resources.body: The official City of Bruges schools directory lists Dutch-medium nursery, primary, secondary, higher and adult-education categories with enrolment resources for the 2026-2027 school year, and identifies no international-curriculum (IB, British or American) school in Bruges (https://www.brugge.be/onderwijs-en-kinderopvang/brugse-scholen).

resources.title: Bruges — Arrival registration
resources.body: A non-Belgian moving from abroad to Bruges must register with the municipality by appointment at Huis van de Bruggeling; after documents are accepted, a neighbourhood inspector verifies the residence before the file proceeds.

resources.title: Bruges — Tax ID
resources.body: For Belgian individuals, the tax identification number is the 11-digit National Number attributed when a person is registered in the National Register (source: https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/topics/policy-issue-focus/aeoi/belgium-tin.pdf). A resident cannot apply for a National registration number separately and receives it upon entry in the Belgian population registers (source: https://sigedis.be/en/our-digital-services/citizens/my-identity/my-identification-number). Flanders directs newcomers to register with their municipality to arrange the number, and Bruges provides the local registration procedure (sources: https://www.vlaanderen.be/en/your-future-in-flanders/need-to-know-before-coming-to-belgium and https://www.brugge.be/burgerzaken/niet-belgen/aankomst-brugge/inschrijving-niet-belg).

resources.title: Bruges — Transport
resources.body: De Lijn operates Bruges city-centre bus service (source: https://www.delijn.be/en/nieuws/brugge-p-r-gratis-tickets/); its official adult Omnipas for ages 25 to 64 costs EUR 62 for one month, plus a EUR 10 MOBIB administrative fee (source: https://www.delijn.be/en/content/vervoerbewijzen/tarieven/).

resources.title: Bruges — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Join an accredited health-insurance fund; those who do not want to join one may join the public Auxiliary Illness and Disability Insurance Fund for free (source: https://www.vlaanderen.be/en/care-and-family/health-insurance).

resources.title: Brussels — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's Brussels cost-of-living page (last updated 18 August 2026) reports EUR 1,226.47 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Brussels). For residential leases concluded or renewed from 1 November 2024, the Brussels-Capital Region caps the rental guarantee at two months' rent under Article 248 of the Code bruxellois du Logement (https://be.brussels/fr/logement/location/bail-dhabitation/garantie-locative). Immoweb has a dedicated Brussels City (1000) apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/brussels/1000).

resources.title: Brussels — Banking
resources.body: Newcomers need valid passport/ID card and proof of belgian residence (utility bill or lease). Banks: ING Belgium (ing.be), BNP Paribas Fortis.

resources.title: Brussels — Schools
resources.body: Brussels offers IB, British, American, European Schools and more. 10+ IB World Schools available.

resources.title: Brussels — Arrival registration
resources.body: Foreign nationals must register at their local municipality (commune) within 8 days of arrival. Registration leads to residence card and National Number.

resources.title: Brussels — Tax ID
resources.body: Belgian Tax ID is the National Register Number (NN/RRN), assigned automatically upon commune registration. Non-residents may obtain a BIS number from FPS Finance.

resources.title: Brussels — Transport
resources.body: STIB/MIVB operates metro, tram and bus network. Monthly pass EUR 56 (STIB network only). EU licences valid; non-EU must exchange at commune. Healthcare: register with a mutuality (mutualité) within 3 months.

resources.title: Ghent — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's Gent cost-of-living table (last updated 23 July 2026) reports EUR 1,055.62 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Gent). The Vlaams Woninghuurdecreet of 9 November 2018 caps the rental guarantee for dwellings in the Flemish Region (which includes Ghent) at a maximum of three months' rent, in force since 1 January 2019 (https://codex.vlaanderen.be/PrintDocument.ashx?id=1029963&datum=&geannoteerd=false&print=false). Immoweb has a dedicated Ghent (postcode 9000) apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/ghent/9000).

resources.title: Ghent — Banking
resources.body: Requires: valid passport/ID and proof of Belgian residence. Banks: ING Belgium, Belfius.

resources.title: Ghent — Schools
resources.body: International schools in Ghent offering IB and Flemish curricula.

resources.title: Ghent — Arrival registration
resources.body: Register at Ghent city administration within 8 days of arrival.

resources.title: Ghent — Tax ID
resources.body: Tax ID is National Register Number (NN/RRN)� assigned automatically upon commune registration.

resources.title: Ghent — Transport
resources.body: De Lijn operates buses and trams in Ghent. Monthly Omnipas (adult 25-64): EUR 62/month. EU licences valid; non-EU must exchange. Healthcare: register with mutuality.

resources.title: Burnaby — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's July 2026 Burnaby table reports CAD 2,350 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Burnaby. British Columbia caps a security deposit at half of the first month's rent: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/housing-tenancy/residential-tenancies/starting-a-tenancy/deposits-fees. Rentals.ca provides a Burnaby-specific rental listings portal: https://rentals.ca/burnaby.

resources.title: Burnaby — Banking
resources.body: TD Canada Trust's official newcomer page requires one residency identification document, such as a permanent resident card, record of landing, confirmation of permanent residence, work permit or study permit, plus one personal identification document, such as a valid passport, Canadian driver's licence or Canadian government ID card: https://www.td.com/ca/en/personal-banking/solutions/new-to-canada/bank-accounts-for-newcomers. RBC's official newcomer guide also identifies proof of identity, immigration status and address as usual account-opening documents: https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/en-ca/my-money-matters/life-events/new-to-canada/banking-in-canada/newcomer-banking-guide/.

resources.title: Burnaby — Schools
resources.body: Burnaby School District offers Early French Immersion from kindergarten and Late French Immersion from Grade 6; students follow the British Columbia curriculum, with instruction delivered in French: https://burnabyschools.ca/french-immersion. The district's official elementary-school directory lists schools, addresses and French Immersion catchments: https://burnabyschools.ca/elementary-school-addresses.

resources.title: Burnaby — Arrival registration
resources.body: For newcomers settling as permanent residents, IRCC requires entry documents and two border screening interviews; if there are no issues, the CBSA officer signs the Confirmation of Permanent Residence and authorizes entry as a permanent resident: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/settle-canada/border-crossing.html.

resources.title: Burnaby — Tax ID
resources.body: The CRA identifies the nine-digit Social Insurance Number (SIN) as the primary newcomer identifier used for tax and benefit purposes and directs eligible newcomers to apply through Service Canada; if Service Canada cannot issue a SIN, CRA may issue a Temporary Tax Number: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/international-non-residents/individuals-leaving-entering-canada-non-residents/newcomers-canada-immigrants.html. Service Canada's application page supports first-time SIN applications and provides the required-document process: https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/sin/apply.html.

resources.title: Burnaby — Transport
resources.body: TransLink is Metro Vancouver's public-transport network; its adult 1-Zone Monthly Pass costs CAD 117.20 from July 1, 2026: https://www.translink.ca/transit-fares/pricing-and-fare-zones. New B.C. residents have 90 days to switch a valid foreign licence; licences from exchange jurisdictions can transfer without additional testing, while others require a knowledge and road test: https://icbc.com/driver-licensing/moving-bc/moving-from-another-country. B.C. residents must enrol in the Medical Services Plan (MSP); newcomers should apply as soon as they arrive, online, by mail or in person, and provide identity and status documents: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/health/health-drug-coverage/msp/bc-residents/eligibility-and-enrolment/apply-for-msp.

resources.title: Mississauga — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports C$2,395.83 monthly for a one-bedroom apartment in Mississauga city centre, updated 2 September 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Mississauga Ontario permits a last-month's-rent deposit and limits it to one month for a monthly tenancy: https://files.ontario.ca/mmah-guide-to-standard-lease-for-rental-housing-en-2022-04-19.pdf Rentals.ca provides a Mississauga rental-search portal: https://rentals.ca/mississauga

resources.title: Mississauga — Banking
resources.body: TD's official newcomer page requires one residency ID plus one personal ID and proof of enrolment for international students: https://www.td.com/ca/en/personal-banking/solutions/new-to-canada/bank-accounts-for-newcomers RBC's official newcomer page also offers newcomer banking and lists passport, driver's licence, PR card or work permit, and SIN among documents to have ready: https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/new-to-canada/just-arrived/

resources.title: Mississauga — Schools
resources.body: The International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme is available at Erindale Secondary School in Mississauga: https://erindale.peelschools.org/international-baccalaureate Ontario's public-school contact dataset is the schools directory and includes school names, addresses, contacts, websites, board details, language and grade range: https://data.ontario.ca/en/dataset/ontario-public-school-contact-information

resources.title: Mississauga — Arrival registration
resources.body: For newcomers becoming Canadian permanent residents, IRCC automatically sends the first PR card when the newcomer supplies a Canadian mailing address and photo within 180 days; an address can be given at the port of entry or online after landing: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/permanent-residents/card/apply.html

resources.title: Mississauga — Tax ID
resources.body: The Social Insurance Number is the nine-digit identifier used for income-tax purposes: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/topics/about-your-tax-return/tax-return/completing-a-tax-return/personal-address-information/social-insurance-number.html A newcomer obtains or updates a SIN through Service Canada online, by mail, or in person with the required primary status/identity document and secondary identity document: https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/sin/apply.html

resources.title: Mississauga — Transport
resources.body: MiWay is Mississauga's public-transport network, and its adult PRESTO monthly pass costs C$145 from 1 January 2026: https://www.mississauga.ca/miway-transit/announcements/miway-fares-will-change-on-thursday-january-1/

resources.title: Mississauga — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Eligible newcomers apply for OHIP in person at a ServiceOntario centre with a completed registration form and three separate documents proving eligible status, Ontario residency and identity; there is no waiting period: https://www.ontario.ca/page/apply-ohip-and-get-health-card

resources.title: Regina — Banking
resources.body: RBC says newcomers opening an account must be at least 18 and live in Canada, and it verifies identity from original government-issued documents.

resources.title: Regina — Schools
resources.body: Luther College High School in Regina offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in grades 11 and 12; Saskatchewan publishes an official list of independent schools that includes Luther College High School.

resources.title: Regina — Arrival registration
resources.body: For a newly landed permanent resident, provide a Canadian address to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada within 180 days of arrival so the first permanent resident card can be delivered.

resources.title: Regina — Tax ID
resources.body: Obtain a Social Insurance Number from Service Canada by applying online, by mail or in person with one status-proving primary identity document and one valid secondary identity document showing legal name and date of birth.

resources.title: Regina — Transport
resources.body: Regina Transit is the municipal network and its adult monthly pass is CAD 97. New Saskatchewan residents may drive on a valid out-of-province licence for 90 days; eligible licences from honoured jurisdictions may be exchanged, while non-recognized licences require examination. Newcomers register for public healthcare by applying for a Saskatchewan health card through Saskatchewan Account and providing proof of legal entitlement to Canada and Saskatchewan residence.

resources.title: Windsor — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's June 2026 contributor dataset reports C$1,660 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Windsor city centre. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Windsor Ontario limits a monthly rent deposit to one month's rent for the last rental period. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/getting-settled-ontario Windsor rental listings are available through Rentals.ca. Source: https://rentals.ca/windsor-on

resources.title: Windsor — Banking
resources.body: RBC says newcomers opening an account must be at least 18 and live in Canada, and should have original government-issued identification rather than photocopies, including a passport, driver's licence, PR card or work permit, and SIN. Source: https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/new-to-canada/bank-offers-for-permanent-resident-and-foreign-worker-newcomers/

resources.title: Windsor — Schools
resources.body: Windsor's Assumption College Catholic Middle School offers the International Baccalaureate Middle Years Programme, and Assumption College Catholic High School offers the IB Diploma Programme. Sources: https://www.wecdsb.on.ca/programs/international_baccalaureate/assumption_college_catholic_middle_school https://www.wecdsb.on.ca/programs/international_baccalaureate/assumption_college_catholic_high_school Ontario's official directory lists publicly funded elementary and secondary schools. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/list-elementary-and-secondary-schools

resources.title: Windsor — Arrival registration
resources.body: For a new permanent resident, IRCC requires a Canadian mailing address and photo within 180 days of receiving PR status so the first PR card can be issued; the address can be given at the port of entry or online. Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/permanent-residents/card/apply.html

resources.title: Windsor — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a Social Insurance Number applies through Service Canada online, by mail, or in person; the official application tool identifies the documents required for the applicant's situation. Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/sin/apply.html

resources.title: Windsor — Transport
resources.body: Transit Windsor's adult 30-day Smart Pass costs C$124. Source: https://www.citywindsor.ca/residents/transit-windsor/fares A new Ontario resident may use a valid foreign licence for 60 days, then must switch; direct exchange depends on the issuing jurisdiction, while non-reciprocal jurisdictions require tests. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/exchange-out-province-drivers-licence Eligible residents register for OHIP in person at ServiceOntario with a completed form and three qualifying documents proving status, Ontario residency, and identity. Source: https://www.ontario.ca/page/apply-ohip-and-get-health-card

resources.title: Dortmund — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reported an August 2026 average of EUR 650 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Dortmund city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Dortmund). Verbraucherzentrale says the deposit is generally three months of rent (https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/laura-zieht-aus/mietvertrag). ImmoScout24 provides Dortmund rental listings (https://www.immobilienscout24.de/regional/de/nordrhein-westfalen/dortmund/).

resources.title: Dortmund — Banking
resources.body: Sparkasse Dortmund publishes current-account opening and official identity-check instructions; a valid identity document such as an identity card or passport is required for Video-Ident, while eID requires a valid identity document with its PIN (https://www.sparkasse-dortmund.de/de/home/service/videolegitimation.html).

resources.title: Dortmund — Schools
resources.body: Leibniz Gymnasium Dortmund is an IB World School offering the IB Diploma Programme alongside the German Abitur (https://leibniz-gym.de/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/FAQ.pdf). The City of Dortmund School Atlas is the official searchable school directory (https://www.dortmund.de/services/schulatlas-schulen-in-dortmund.html).

resources.title: Dortmund — Arrival registration
resources.body: Register a new Dortmund residence with the City of Dortmund Bürgerdienste within two weeks of moving in; bring identity/passport documents and the landlord confirmation (https://www.dortmund.de/services/wohnsitzanmeldung.html).

resources.title: Dortmund — Tax ID
resources.body: The Federal Central Tax Office automatically assigns the German tax identification number when a new citizen first registers in Germany; if no letter arrives within three months, request the number from BZSt (https://online.portal.bzst.de/SharedDocs/Leistungsbeschreibung/EN/erneute_mitteilung_der_ID-Nr.html).

resources.title: Dortmund — Transport
resources.body: DSW21 is Dortmund local public transport and operates buses, trains and the H-Bahn (https://www.bus-und-bahn.de/en/about-us); its DeutschlandTicket costs EUR 63 per month (https://www.bus-und-bahn.de/tickets). EU/EEA licences normally remain valid, while non-EU/EEA licences are recognized for six months after establishing normal residence and then require a German licence, with conditions depending on the issuing country (https://bmdv.bund.de/SharedDocs/EN/Articles/StV/Roadtraffic/validity-foreign-driving-licences-in-germany.html). Residents must have health insurance; a newcomer with no prior statutory or private cover may contact any statutory health fund to determine statutory or private eligibility (https://www.bundesgesundheitsministerium.de/en/themen/krankenversicherung/online-ratgeber-krankenversicherung/krankenversicherung/statutory-health-insurance-shi).

resources.title: Mannheim — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo listed €803.56 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Mannheim city centre, updated 17 July 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Mannheim?displayCurrency=EUR The statutory rental-deposit ceiling is three months of net rent, not a claimed market norm: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__551.html Current Mannheim rental listings are available on ImmoScout24: https://www.immobilienscout24.de/Suche/de/baden-wuerttemberg/mannheim/wohnung-mieten?enteredFrom=result_list

resources.title: Mannheim — Banking
resources.body: Sparkasse Rhein Neckar Nord says a current-account applicant supplies personal information and completes identity verification with a valid identity card or passport: https://www.sparkasse-rhein-neckar-nord.de/de/home/privatkunden/girokonto.html Its account-opening terms also require the account holder tax identification number: https://www.sparkasse-rhein-neckar-nord.de/de/home/privatkunden/girokonto/girokonto-classic-free.html

resources.title: Mannheim — Schools
resources.body: The official city profile for Liselotte-Gymnasium documents a German-English bilingual profile and the International Abitur Baden-Württemberg: https://www.mannheim.de/de/bildung-staerken/weiterfuehrende-schulen/allgemeinbildende-gymnasien/liselotte The city school directory is Schulatlas Mannheim: https://web2.mannheim.de/schulatlas/

resources.title: Mannheim — Arrival registration
resources.body: Anyone moving into a Mannheim dwelling must register within two weeks with Mannheim Bürgerservice; registration is available at Bürgerservice locations or digitally, and the city lists the required identity document, registration form and landlord confirmation: https://www.mannheim.de/de/service-bieten/buergerdienste/buergerservice/dienstleistungen/meldeangelegenheiten/an-und-ummeldung-eines-wohnsitzes

resources.title: Mannheim — Tax ID
resources.body: After first registration in Germany, the registration authority transmits the data and the Federal Central Tax Office assigns the IdNr; if it has not arrived after three months, the newcomer may send the BZSt a copy of the identity document and registration confirmation: https://www.bzst.de/DE/Privatpersonen/SteuerlicheIdentifikationsnummer/FAQ/faq_node.html

resources.title: Mannheim — Transport
resources.body: VRN sells the 2026 Deutschland-Ticket for €63 per month, valid on local buses, trams and regional trains: https://www.vrn.de/tickets/ticketuebersicht/deutschlandticket/index.html Mannheim states that EU licences can be exchanged without a test, while non-EU licences are valid for six months and exchange requirements depend on whether the issuing state appears in FeV Annex 11: https://www.mannheim.de/de/service-bieten/buergerdienste/buergerservice/dienstleistungen/fuehrerscheine/umschreibung-auslaendische-fahrerlaubnis-und-dienstfahrerlaubnis For statutory healthcare, choose an eligible Krankenkasse and notify the employer of the chosen fund: https://www.bundesgesundheitsministerium.de/service/begriffe-von-a-z/k/krankenkasse/

resources.title: Munich — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reported EUR 1,532.09 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Munich city centre, last updated 1 September 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Munich?displayCurrency=EUR. German Civil Code section 551 caps a residential cash deposit at three months of rent excluding operating costs: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__551.html. Munich's housing office names ImmobilienScout24 and ImmoWelt as popular online property portals: https://stadt.muenchen.de/service/en-GB/info/fachbereich-wohnen/10426348/.

resources.title: Munich — Banking
resources.body: N26's official Germany page says its account requires a smartphone, a valid German address and valid photo ID; its detailed process identifies a passport or national ID and video identity verification: https://n26.com/en-de/blog/how-to-open-a-bank-account-in-germany.

resources.title: Munich — Schools
resources.body: Munich offers IB, British and French curricula. Bavarian International School's official page lists all four IB programmes: https://www.bis-school.com/about/bis-at-a-glance. St. George's official FAQ lists the English National Curriculum, IGCSE and IB: https://munich.stgeorgesschool.com/faq. Lycee Jean Renoir's official page states that it follows French Ministry of Education programmes: https://www.lycee-jean-renoir.de/letablissement/.

resources.title: Munich — Arrival registration
resources.body: Register the Munich residence within 14 days after moving in, online for a main residence or in person at a Munich Citizens Office; valid identification and landlord confirmation are required: https://stadt.muenchen.de/service/en-GB/info/residence-registration/10424740/n0/.

resources.title: Munich — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer is automatically assigned a lifelong tax identification number after first registration in Germany. If no notification arrives within three months, request renewed communication from the Federal Central Tax Office: https://online.portal.bzst.de/SharedDocs/Leistungsbeschreibung/EN/erneute_mitteilung_der_ID-Nr.html.

resources.title: Munich — Transport
resources.body: MVV is the unified local transport system for Munich and the surrounding area: https://www.mvv-muenchen.de/en/mvv-at-a-glance/. MVG sells the Deutschlandticket for EUR 63 per month across the entire MVV area and German local and regional transport: https://www.mvg.de/abos-tickets/abos/deutschlandticket.html. A foreign licence is usable for six months after first registration, then must be transferred; non-EU/EEA licences generally require theory and practical tests unless an Annex 11 exception applies: https://stadt.muenchen.de/service/en-GB/info/fuhrerscheinstelle/10424591/. Health insurance is compulsory and most people use a statutory fund; eligible newcomers choose a fund, apply to it and inform their employer or contribution-paying body: https://gesund.bund.de/en/krankenversicherung and https://www.tk.de/en/become-tk-member-2038024.

resources.title: Córdoba — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reported a contributor-based average of EUR 662.50 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Córdoba city centre, last updated 19 June 2026. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Cordoba-Spain Article 36 of the Spanish Urban Leases Act sets the mandatory cash deposit for a dwelling at one month of rent. Source: https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1994-26003&tn=1 Idealista provides a Córdoba rental-listings portal. Source: https://www.idealista.com/en/alquiler-viviendas/cordoba-cordoba/

resources.title: Córdoba — Banking
resources.body: For the Santander Non-Resident Account, applicants must be over 18 and provide a valid passport; Spanish non-residents may use a DNI. Foreign tax residents identify themselves with an NIE, while EU residents need their EU Citizen Registration Certificate and passport. Source: https://www.bancosantander.es/en/particulares/cuentas-bancarias/cuenta-online-con-pasaporte

resources.title: Córdoba — Schools
resources.body: The British School of Córdoba documents the English National Curriculum and Cambridge IGCSE in secondary, and the IB Diploma Programme plus AS and A Level options in sixth form. Sources: https://www.colegiobritanicodecordoba.com/en/curriculum/secondary https://colegiobritanicodecordoba.com/en/curriculum/sixth-form The NABSS directory identifies it as the only authorised British school in the province. Source: https://nabss.org/colegios-nabss/british-school-of-cordoba/

resources.title: Córdoba — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer establishing residence in Córdoba registers or changes address in the Municipal Population Register by completing form 60-444 and submitting identity and occupancy evidence to Córdoba City Council. Foreign nationals provide an NIE or valid passport; EU foreign nationals provide an NIE and a current identity document from their country of origin. Source: https://www.cordoba.es/tramites/padron-de-habitantes/alta-o-inscripcion-y-traslado-de-domicilio-en-el-padron-municipal-de-habitantes

resources.title: Córdoba — Tax ID
resources.body: A natural person needs a Spanish NIF for tax-relevant transactions; it generally coincides with the DNI or NIE. A foreign national without a DNI or NIE can request a NIF from the Spanish Tax Agency using Modelo 030. Source: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/censos-nif-domicilio-fiscal/solicitar-nif.html

resources.title: Córdoba — Transport
resources.body: AUCORSA is the municipal company providing public urban transport in Córdoba. Source: https://aucorsa.es/quienes-somos/ Its subsidised Tarjeta 30 días costs EUR 20 for 2026. Source: https://aucorsa.es/titulos-y-tarifas/ EU and EEA licences remain valid while current; qualifying non-EU licences are valid for at most six months after normal residence begins, then must be exchanged where an agreement exists or replaced by obtaining a Spanish licence. Source: https://www.dgt.es/nuestros-servicios/permisos-de-conducir/permisos-extranjeros-y-de-fuerzas-y-cuerpos-de-seguridad/conducir-con-un-permiso-extranjero Andalusian residents whose public coverage is recognised by INSS apply at the nearest primary-care centre with identity, INSS coverage proof and empadronamiento, using the health-card or BDU registration form. Source: https://www.sspa.juntadeandalucia.es/servicioandaluzdesalud/ciudadania/cobertura-sanitaria/personas-residentes-en-andalucia-con-cobertura-sanitaria

resources.title: Valladolid — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports EUR 614.40 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Valladolid city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Valladolid. Spain's Urban Leases Act sets the mandatory housing deposit at one month's rent: https://www.boe.es/eli/es/l/1994/11/24/29/. Idealista has a Valladolid-city rental listings portal: https://www.idealista.com/alquiler-viviendas/valladolid-valladolid/.

resources.title: Valladolid — Banking
resources.body: BBVA's official guidance says foreign applicants use, depending on status, NIE (EU residents), TIE (non-EU residents), or passport (resident or non-resident foreigners, with branch attendance); BBVA may additionally request a payslip, employment contract, or latest IRPF return: https://www.bbva.es/finanzas-vistazo/tu-guia-bbva/cuentas/como-abrir-una-cuenta-bancaria-en-espana-si-eres-extranjero.html.

resources.title: Valladolid — Schools
resources.body: British curriculum is available at International School of Valladolid: https://colegio-internacional-valladolid.dukeseducation.es/en/. The Junta de Castilla y León lists the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in Valladolid: https://www.educa.jcyl.es/es/informacion/sistema-educativo/bachillerato/bachillerato. The Ministry of Education's national non-university school directory is: https://www.educacionfpydeportes.gob.es/contenidos/centros-docentes/buscar-centro-no-universitario.html.

resources.title: Valladolid — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer taking up residence in Valladolid should register an alta in the Padrón Municipal de Habitantes with Valladolid City Council's population service: https://www.valladolid.es/es/temas/hacemos/padron-habitantes.

resources.title: Valladolid — Tax ID
resources.body: For an individual, Spain's tax identification number (NIF) generally coincides with the DNI or NIE. A foreign individual without an NIE who needs to carry out a tax-relevant transaction can request a NIF from the Agencia Tributaria: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/censos-nif-domicilio-fiscal/solicitar-nif/nif-persona-fisica.html.

resources.title: Valladolid — Transport
resources.body: Valladolid's AUVASA urban bus network offers the ordinary Bono30 at EUR 22.80 for 30 days of unlimited travel: https://www.auvasa.es/tarifas-y-medios-de-pago/. Spain's DGT says residents may exchange licences from EU/EEA countries and countries with an exchange agreement, plus professional licences from countries without an agreement: https://www.dgt.es/nuestros-servicios/permisos-de-conducir/permisos-extranjeros-y-de-fuerzas-y-cuerpos-de-seguridad/canjes-de-permisos/canjes-de-permisos-extranjeros/index.html. For public healthcare in Valladolid, apply for the SACYL health card at the health centre assigned to the home address with the documentation required for the applicant's status: https://www.saludcastillayleon.es/es/serviciosonline/tarjeta-sanitaria/informacion-procedimiento.

resources.title: Espoo — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports a June 2026 average of EUR 955/month for a one-bedroom apartment in Espoo city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Espoo. InfoFinland says the usual security deposit is two months' rent (maximum three): https://infofinland.fi/housing/rental-home/tenancy-agreement. The City of Espoo lists Oikotie for private and company rentals: https://www.espoo.fi/en/articles/i-am-looking-housing-or-i-am-moving-new-home.

resources.title: Espoo — Banking
resources.body: Nordea's official newcomer page requires a valid accepted identity document, proof of right of residence (a residence permit or pending-application certificate for non-EU citizens, or EU right-of-residence registration), and its completed customer form for the branch meeting; a Finnish personal identity number is recommended: https://www.nordea.fi/en/personal/bank-with-us/become-a-customer/new-to-finland.html.

resources.title: Espoo — Schools
resources.body: Espoo International School is an IB-authorized English-language school offering MYP in grades 7-9: https://www.espoo.fi/en/childcare-and-education/basic-education/comprehensive-schools/espoo-international-school. Espoo's upper-secondary directory says Mattlidens gymnasium and Etela-Tapiolan lukio offer the English-language IB Diploma Programme and links the city's school map: https://www.espoo.fi/en/welcome-upper-secondary-school.

resources.title: Espoo — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer without a Finnish personal identity code applies to the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV) to register personal data in the Population Information System and may apply for a municipality of residence on the same form; everyone requesting a code must visit DVV in person within one month: https://dvv.fi/en/foreigner-registration.

resources.title: Espoo — Tax ID
resources.body: A worker who needs a Finnish tax card or tax number must first have a Finnish personal identity code. For tax-related work, the newcomer can request the code from the Finnish Tax Administration by booking and visiting an eligible service point with the registration/application forms, identity document, and work evidence; an individual tax number is mandatory for construction-site and shipyard work: https://www.vero.fi/en/individuals/tax-cards-and-tax-returns/arriving_in_finland/work_in_finland/finnish-personal-identity-codes-for-workers-arriving-in-finland/.

resources.title: Espoo — Transport
resources.body: Helsinki Regional Transport Authority (HSL) serves Espoo: https://www.hsl.fi/en/hsl/new-terms-of-use/hsl-public-transport-conditions-of-carriage-and-ticket-terms-and-conditions. HSL's 2026 price list sets a resident adult 30-day two-zone season ticket at EUR 73.90: https://staticfiles.hsl.fi/globalassets/hsl/uutisten-pdf-liitteet/lippujen-hinnat_a4_01012026_en_final.pdf. Traficom says EU/EEA licences remain valid until expiry, Contracting-State licences for two years after permanent relocation, and other recognized-country licences for one year after population registration: https://traficom.fi/en/drivers-and-vehicles/driving-licenses/exchanging-foreign-driving-licence-finnish-driving-licence. In Espoo, Western Uusimaa assigns the public health centre by home address: https://www.luvn.fi/en/services/health-services/health-stations/find-your-health-centre; register address and municipality of residence with DVV: https://dvv.fi/en/foreigner-registration.

resources.title: Helsinki — Housing
resources.body: February 2026 indicative average asking rent for a 1-bedroom city-centre apartment: EUR 1,081.07 (https://finorum.com/rent-prices-europe-2026/). Finnish security deposits usually equal two months' rent and may not exceed three months (https://infofinland.fi/housing/rental-home/tenancy-agreement). Vuokraovi identifies itself as Finland's largest rental-home search marketplace (https://www.vuokraovi.com/).

resources.title: Helsinki — Banking
resources.body: Nordea's official newcomer page says applicants need a valid accepted identity document, proof of right of residence in Finland, and its completed customer form; a Finnish personal identity number is recommended and speeds the process. https://www.nordea.fi/en/personal/bank-with-us/become-a-customer/new-to-finland.html

resources.title: Helsinki — Schools
resources.body: Helsinki offers fully English IB study, a fully English Finnish national upper-secondary track, and an American High School diploma option; the same City of Helsinki page lists Helsinki's international and language-programme schools. https://www.hel.fi/en/childhood-and-education/general-upper-secondary-education/studies-in-general-upper-secondary-school/general-upper-secondary-education-in-different-languages

resources.title: Helsinki — Arrival registration
resources.body: Foreign newcomers should request a Finnish personal identity code and, if eligible, a municipality of residence online, then book and attend a Digital and Population Data Services Agency appointment in person within one month with the required identity and residence, work, or study evidence. https://dvv.fi/en/foreigner-registration

resources.title: Helsinki — Tax ID
resources.body: A worker who needs a Finnish personal identity code for tax purposes must book and visit an issuing Tax Administration service point, complete form 6150e plus form 5057e (stay up to six months) or 5042e (stay over six months), and bring identity, work, and where applicable residence-right documents. https://www.vero.fi/en/individuals/tax-cards-and-tax-returns/arriving_in_finland/work_in_finland/finnish-personal-identity-codes-for-workers-arriving-in-finland/

resources.title: Helsinki — Transport
resources.body: Helsinki Region Transport (HSL) operates the capital-area network; most of Helsinki is in zones AB and an adult AB season ticket costs EUR 61.60 per 30 days with a yearly commitment. https://www.hel.fi/en/urban-environment-and-traffic/getting-around-helsinki-tips-for-newcomers Driving-licence exchange timing depends on the issuing country. https://traficom.fi/en/drivers-and-vehicles/driving-licenses/exchanging-foreign-driving-licence-finnish-driving-licence Registered Helsinki residents are automatically assigned a local health station by home address. https://www.hel.fi/en/health-and-social-services/welcome-helsinki-tips-for-health-and-social-services/welcome-helsinki-health-services

resources.title: Helsinki — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Register as a Helsinki resident; the city then automatically assigns a health station based on the home address. The city also advises applying for a Kela card shortly after arrival. https://www.hel.fi/en/health-and-social-services/welcome-helsinki-tips-for-health-and-social-services/welcome-helsinki-health-services

resources.title: Bordeaux — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's August 2026 contributor-based average for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment is EUR 784.92 per month. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Bordeaux For an unfurnished lease, France's statutory deposit cap is one month of rent excluding charges. Source: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F31269 SeLoger lists Bordeaux rentals. Source: https://www.seloger.com/immobilier/tout/immo-bordeaux-33/

resources.title: Bordeaux — Banking
resources.body: BNP Paribas requires France-resident adult applicants to present valid identity and proof of address less than three months old; hosted applicants also need a signed hosting certificate plus the host's identity and address documents. Source: https://mabanque.bnpparibas/fr/gerer/comptes-et-formules/compte-individuel

resources.title: Bordeaux — Schools
resources.body: Bordeaux International School documents French and British national curricula in primary, and Cambridge International Education leading to IGCSE and International A Level in upper school. Sources: https://www.bordeaux-school.com/learning/primary https://www.bordeaux-school.com/learning/upper-school The City of Bordeaux school directory is at https://www.bordeaux.fr/ecoles

resources.title: Bordeaux — Arrival registration
resources.body: A non-EU newcomer holding a VLS-TS must validate it online and pay the tax within three months after arrival; the visa then serves as the residence permit for its validity period. Source: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F16162

resources.title: Bordeaux — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer without a numéro fiscal obtains the 13-digit identifier after filing the first income-tax return on paper with the required supporting documents; the tax administration then assigns the number. Source: https://www.impots.gouv.fr/particulier/questions/comment-creer-mon-espace-finances-publiques

resources.title: Bordeaux — Transport
resources.body: TBM is Bordeaux's tram, bus, boat and park-and-ride network; its standard monthly pass for ages 28-59 costs EUR 55.00 and is valid for one calendar month. Source: https://boutique.infotbm.com/products/23

resources.title: Bordeaux — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Send completed Cerfa S1106 and situation-specific identity, residence-status and eligibility documents to the health-insurance fund for the place of residence; this opens rights and produces a temporary NIA while identity is certified. Source: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-france/ne-etranger-demander-numero-securite-sociale

resources.title: Le Havre — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports EUR 450/month for a one-bedroom apartment in Le Havre city centre (last update 28 November 2025): https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Le-Havre-France. For an unfurnished principal-residence lease, the deposit is capped at one month of rent excluding charges; the furnished cap is two months: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F31269. Current Le Havre rental listings are available on leboncoin: https://www.leboncoin.fr/cl/locations/cp_le%20havre_76600

resources.title: Le Havre — Banking
resources.body: Crédit Agricole says a newcomer generally provides a valid official photo ID, proof of address under three months old, and a signature specimen: https://www.credit-agricole.fr/particulier/conseils/magazine/tout-un-mag/tout-ce-qui-faut-savoir-pour-avoir-un-compte-bancaire.html. Crédit Agricole Normandie-Seine is confirmed on its official regional site: https://www.credit-agricole.fr/ca-normandie-seine/particulier.html. BNP Paribas is confirmed by its official Le Havre Président René Coty branch page: https://nos-agences.mabanque.bnpparibas/normandie/seine-maritime/le-havre/agence-le-havre-president-rene-coty-949

resources.title: Le Havre — Schools
resources.body: Institution Saint-Joseph in Le Havre offers a British International Section: https://st-jo.fr/en/highschool/the-british-international-section/. Its current international section leads to the French Baccalaureate International (BFI): https://st-jo.fr/lycee/sections-internationales/. The Académie de Normandie school dataset is the official regional directory: https://data.normandie.education.gouv.fr/explore/dataset/etablissements/

resources.title: Le Havre — Arrival registration
resources.body: A holder of a visa de long séjour valant titre de séjour (VLS-TS) must validate it and pay the tax online within three months after arrival: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F16162. The official Ministry of the Interior procedure is listed at https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/R52684

resources.title: Le Havre — Tax ID
resources.body: A person without a French tax number obtains one after filing a first paper income-tax return with the required supporting documents; the tax administration then assigns the 13-digit numéro fiscal: https://www.impots.gouv.fr/particulier/questions/comment-creer-mon-espace-finances-publiques

resources.title: Le Havre — Transport
resources.body: Le Havre's public-transport network is LiA, whose standard all-public monthly pass costs EUR 45: https://www.transports-lia.fr/fr/trouver-mon-tarif. An EU/EEE licence remains usable while valid and exchange is required only in specified cases: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F1758. A non-EU licence is generally valid for one year after normal residence begins and must be exchanged within that period to keep driving when exchange is available: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F1460. For public healthcare, complete, sign and send form S1106a with situation-specific documents to the applicable CPAM or MSA: https://www.service-public.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/R45084. The local CPAM office is confirmed at https://lannuaire.service-public.fr/normandie/seine-maritime/ab2fc83e-146a-4c68-8878-efca5d99f108

resources.title: Aberdeen — Banking
resources.body: HSBC UK says current-account applicants need proof of identity and proof of address; non-UK nationals from outside the EU or Switzerland may also need a visa or residence permit.

resources.title: Aberdeen — Schools
resources.body: The International School Aberdeen offers the IB Diploma in Grades 11–12 and optional IGCSE qualifications in Grades 9–10; Aberdeen City Council publishes a directory of city schools.

resources.title: Aberdeen — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a National Insurance number applies online and proves identity; a passport or qualifying European national identity card can be used, and an in-person appointment may be required if those documents are unavailable.

resources.title: Aberdeen — Transport
resources.body: First Aberdeen's FirstMonth ticket provides unlimited travel for four weeks for GBP 95. Driving-licence exchange depends on the issuing country and individual circumstances. New residents staying more than three months register with a local GP practice by completing and submitting the registration form.

resources.title: Aberdeen — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Find a local GP practice, contact it, complete the registration form, and submit it as instructed; permanent GP registration is for people staying in the area more than three months: https://www.nhsinform.scot/care-support-and-rights/nhs-services/doctors/registering-with-a-gp-practice/

resources.title: Belfast — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports £886.33 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Belfast city centre, last updated 1 September 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Belfast Northern Ireland caps a private-tenancy deposit at one month's rent: https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/articles/tenancy-deposit-scheme-information-tenants PropertyPal describes itself as NI's favourite property portal with the most NI listings: https://www.propertypal.com/mobile-apps

resources.title: Belfast — Banking
resources.body: Bank of Ireland UK's Clear Account application requires valid photo ID and proof of address; applicants not living in the UK also need their latest three months of current-bank statements: https://www.bankofirelanduk.com/personal/current-account/clear-account/

resources.title: Belfast — Schools
resources.body: Belfast schools follow the statutory Northern Ireland Curriculum across 12 years of compulsory education: https://www.education-ni.gov.uk/articles/statutory-curriculum The Department of Education's Schools Plus service is the official institutions directory: https://www.education-ni.gov.uk/services/schools-plus

resources.title: Belfast — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer with UK immigration permission needs a UKVI account to access an eVisa; after creating the account they must confirm identity and link the account to the eVisa: https://www.gov.uk/evisa/set-up-ukvi-account

resources.title: Belfast — Tax ID
resources.body: Apply online for a National Insurance number and prove identity; a passport or eligible national identity card can be used, while applicants without those documents may need an in-person identity appointment: https://www.gov.uk/apply-national-insurance-number/how-to-apply

resources.title: Belfast — Transport
resources.body: Translink's Belfast Metro and Glider Smartlink adult one-month unlimited travel card costs £63, plus a £1 initial card charge: https://www.translink.co.uk/tickets/travelcards/multi-journey-travelcards/metro-glider-smartlink Licence exchange depends on issuing country: https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/articles/exchanging-your-foreign-driving-licence Newcomers should register with a GP immediately using form HSCR-1: https://online.hscni.net/access-health-social-care/

resources.title: Belfast — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Register with a local GP straight away after arriving in Northern Ireland and complete form HSCR-1; a medical card is issued after registration. https://online.hscni.net/access-health-social-care/

resources.title: Nottingham — Banking
resources.body: HSBC UK's official guidance says applicants need proof of identity and address; it lists passports, driving licences or EU identity cards for identity and utility or telephone bills, council-tax bills, mortgage statements or tenancy agreements for address. It says some non-UK nationals may also need a visa or residence permit (https://www.hsbc.co.uk/current-accounts/what-do-you-need-to-open-a-current-account/).

resources.title: Nottingham — Schools
resources.body: Nottingham Girls' High School's official 2026–27 prospectus documents a GCSE and A-level curriculum (https://nottinghamgirls.gdst.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Senior-Prospectus-2026-2027-ONLINE-1.pdf). Nottingham City Council's 2026 school guide directs families to the statutory DfE directory (https://www.nottinghamcity.gov.uk/media/ljajxrn2/gtsin-2026-v2.pdf; https://get-information-schools.service.gov.uk/).

resources.title: Nottingham — Arrival registration
resources.body: For newcomers whose permission is held as an eVisa, UKVI requires the UKVI account, eVisa details and current passport or travel document to be correct before travel; the eVisa is checked when entering the UK (https://www.gov.uk/evisa/travel-with-evisa).

resources.title: Nottingham — Tax ID
resources.body: Apply online for a National Insurance number and prove identity; GOV.UK says a passport or eligible national identity card can be used and an in-person appointment may be required if those documents are unavailable (https://www.gov.uk/apply-national-insurance-number/how-to-apply).

resources.title: Nottingham — Transport
resources.body: Nottingham City Transport's Easyrider Everyday adult one-month City Zone pass costs £82 from 1 March 2026 (https://www.nctx.co.uk/season-ticket-price-increases). Non-GB licence holders must use the official checker to determine whether and how their licence can be exchanged (https://www.gov.uk/exchange-nongb-driving-licence). Everyone in England can register with a GP surgery for free, usually online or by paper form, without ID, proof of address or immigration status (https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/gps/how-to-register-with-a-gp-surgery/).

resources.title: Bray — Banking
resources.body: AIB requires one original current photo ID and one proof of current permanent address; applicants not currently resident in Ireland need two proof-of-address documents.

resources.title: Bray — Arrival registration
resources.body: After arrival, a person instructed to register and intending to remain more than 90 days should create a Customer Service Portal account and book a first-time in-person registration appointment at the nationwide Burgh Quay Registration Office.

resources.title: Bray — Tax ID
resources.body: Apply online for a Personal Public Service Number through MyWelfare using a MyGovID account and provide identity, address, and evidence of why the number is needed.

resources.title: Navan — Banking
resources.body: AIB requires an original current photo ID and an original proof of current permanent address issued within the past six months; applicants not resident in Ireland need two proof-of-address documents. Source: https://www.aib.ie/our-products/current-accounts/personal-current-account-identity-requirements

resources.title: Navan — Arrival registration
resources.body: People from outside the EU, EEA, UK and Switzerland who intend to stay more than 90 days must register their permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival and make an appointment for first registration at Burgh Quay. Source: https://www.irishimmigration.ie/registering-your-immigration-permission/how-to-register-your-immigration-permission-for-the-first-time/information-on-registering-your-immigration-permission-for-the-first-time/

resources.title: Navan — Tax ID
resources.body: The individual tax reference is the Personal Public Service Number, issued by the Department of Social Protection and used in dealings with Revenue. Adults can apply online through MyWelfare using a MyGovID account and must provide identity, address and reason evidence. Sources: https://www.revenue.ie/en/jobs-and-pensions/personal-public-service-number/index.aspx https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-social-protection/services/get-a-personal-public-service-pps-number/

resources.title: Navan — Transport
resources.body: Navan is in TFI Zone 4; the adult commuter-bus Zones 1-4 monthly ticket is EUR 206.85. EU/EEA licences remain valid while current and may be exchanged; licences from recognised states can be exchanged when normally resident. HSE medical-card or GP-visit-card applications can be made online with PPS numbers, dates of birth, and income and expense details. Sources: https://www.transportforireland.ie/fares/new-fare-zones/ https://www.ndls.ie/licensed-driver/exchange-my-foreign-driving-licence.html https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards/applying/apply/

resources.title: Swords — Banking
resources.body: Bank of Ireland's Coming to Ireland process accepts applications up to 45 days before a move and requires valid photo identification, proof of address and a selfie.

resources.title: Swords — Arrival registration
resources.body: People from outside the EU, EEA, UK or Switzerland who intend to stay more than 90 days must register their permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival and make a Registration Office appointment.

resources.title: Swords — Tax ID
resources.body: Apply online for a PPS Number with a basic MyGovID account, give a valid reason such as starting a job to pay tax, and attend the required in-person appointment.

resources.title: Swords — Transport
resources.body: TFI Dublin's adult Zone 1 monthly ticket costs EUR 96 at https://www.transportforireland.ie/fares/new-fare-zones/. NDLS licence-exchange rules are at https://www.ndls.ie/licensed-driver/exchange-my-foreign-driving-licence. HSE medical-card and GP-visit-card applications are at https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards/applying/apply/.

resources.title: Waterford — Banking
resources.body: AIB says a personal bank-account applicant must provide the original of one photo ID and one proof of address; someone not currently resident in Ireland needs two proof-of-address documents.

resources.title: Waterford — Arrival registration
resources.body: People from outside the EU, EEA, UK, or Switzerland who intend to remain in Ireland for more than 90 days must register their permission with Immigration Service Delivery within 90 days of arrival. First registrations nationwide are by appointment at the ISD Registration Office in Dublin.

resources.title: Waterford — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a Personal Public Service Number for a valid reason can apply through MyWelfare with a basic MyGovID account, book the required in-person appointment during the application, and bring the requested documents.

resources.title: Waterford — Transport
resources.body: TFI Leap Card identifies Bus Éireann Waterford City services and lists an adult Waterford City Red Zone monthly ticket at EUR 54. Driving-licence exchange depends on the issuing jurisdiction. The HSE provides online applications for medical cards and GP visit cards.

resources.title: Waterford — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Apply online for a medical card or GP visit card and provide PPS numbers, dates of birth, and income and expense details: https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards/applying/apply/

resources.title: Bari — Banking
resources.body: BPER Banca's official guidance says foreign nationals opening a current account must present a valid passport or identity card and residence permit; a tax code is also required if already assigned to a person who is not an Italian tax resident.

resources.title: Bari — Schools
resources.body: Istituto Preziosissimo Sangue in Bari offers a bilingual Italian primary programme with Cambridge International School-guided Global Perspectives and English as a Second Language elements; a Bari-wide public/private schools directory is provided.

resources.title: Bari — Arrival registration
resources.body: A person moving their habitual residence to Bari from abroad must submit a residence declaration to the municipal Registry Office; the official online service requires authentication.

resources.title: Bari — Tax ID
resources.body: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. First-time foreign applicants must book an in-person appointment for identity verification; EU citizens may apply at any Revenue Agency office with the request and valid ID, while specified non-EU cases are handled by immigration desks or police headquarters and other cases by the Revenue Agency.

resources.title: Bergamo — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that a foreign citizen resident in Italy may open its XME account only with an Italian codice fiscale; online identification for a new customer uses an accepted Italian identity document and, when requested, the health card.

resources.title: Bergamo — Schools
resources.body: The International School of Bergamo states that it is Bergamo's only authorised IB Continuum School and offers the International Baccalaureate across primary, middle, and high school years, including the Diploma Programme.

resources.title: Bergamo — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer transferring from abroad to Bergamo must submit a residence declaration to the Comune di Bergamo, either online with CNS, SPID, or CIE authentication or in person by appointment.

resources.title: Bergamo — Tax ID
resources.body: A first Italian tax identification number requires an in-person appointment for identity verification; EU citizens apply at an Italian Revenue Agency office with the request and valid ID, while non-EU citizens may receive it through the immigration desk or Questura in specified immigration cases, otherwise through the Revenue Agency.

resources.title: Bergamo — Transport
resources.body: ATB's 2025 Mobility Charter lists a EUR 36 one-zone monthly pass. Driving-licence rules are from Italy's Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport at https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera and healthcare registration guidance is from ATS Bergamo at https://ats-bg.it/cittadini-comunitari.

resources.title: Bergamo — Healthcare registration
resources.body: For Bergamo, an eligible newcomer requests mandatory or voluntary SSR/SSN registration at the competent ASST territorial office; Bergamo city is served by ASST Papa Giovanni XXIII. Source: https://ats-bg.it/cittadini-comunitari

resources.title: Bolzano — Banking
resources.body: Official pages confirm account offerings from Intesa Sanpaolo (https://www.intesasanpaolo.com/content/internetbanking/it/faq/common/faqHome/apertura-xme-conto-online.privati.html) and Bolzano-based Cassa di Risparmio di Bolzano (Sparkasse) (https://www.sparkasse.it/privati-e-famiglie/prodotti/conti-correnti/). Intesa states that a foreign resident needs an Italian codice fiscale and identifies new customers using an accepted identity document.

resources.title: Bolzano — Schools
resources.body: Campus Fagen in Bolzano is an authorized IB Middle Years Programme school; its Diploma Programme is only a candidate programme and is not counted as available (https://www.campusfagen.com/de/ausbildung/international-program.html). The Autonomous Province directory lists Bolzano state and paritaria upper-secondary schools (https://assets-eu-01.kc-usercontent.com/7ea6cc85-bc0d-01f3-7f75-32fd91efe5e0/acc9307f-98f2-4f3f-a471-100a069082f8/A4_Elenco_superiori.pdf).

resources.title: Bolzano — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer who will live stably in Bolzano must submit a residence declaration to the municipal Registry Office; foreign citizens must also demonstrate lawful-stay requirements.

resources.title: Bolzano — Tax ID
resources.body: Foreign citizens obtain Italy's tax identification number, the codice fiscale, through the Immigration Desk or Questura in specified residence-permit cases, or otherwise by applying in person at an Italian Revenue Agency office; a first application requires an appointment and identity verification.

resources.title: Bolzano — Transport
resources.body: The official südtirolmobil Fix30 page gives EUR 39 per month for all public transport in South Tyrol (https://www.suedtirolmobil.info/en/tickets/ticket-finder/suedtirolmobil-fix30-pass). Italy's Transport Ministry explains licence rules (https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera). South Tyrol's CIVIS service directs eligible applicants to the administrative office of the health district nearest their residence (https://mycivis.civis.bz.it/de/Services/ServiceDetail/?id=1721).

resources.title: Brescia — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that online account opening requires a valid identity card, driving licence or passport plus an Italian tax code or valid health card.

resources.title: Brescia — Schools
resources.body: The Brescia international-schools directory lists International Baccalaureate programmes, including PYP, MYP and DP offerings.

resources.title: Brescia — Arrival registration
resources.body: New arrivals must promptly declare residence to the Comune di Brescia registry; first registrations from abroad use the municipal declaration form and supporting documents.

resources.title: Brescia — Tax ID
resources.body: Foreign citizens obtain the Italian codice fiscale through the immigration desk, police headquarters or Revenue Agency depending on their situation; first-time applicants must attend an in-person identity check.

resources.title: Catania — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo says online account opening requires a current identity document and a current codice fiscale or health card.

resources.title: Catania — Schools
resources.body: The Catania directory lists one international school using a bespoke curriculum taught in German and Italian.

resources.title: Catania — Arrival registration
resources.body: Foreign citizens changing residence to Catania must register with the municipal Anagrafe within 60 days; foreign-resident changes are handled through Centro Direzionale San Leone, PEC, or post.

resources.title: Catania — Tax ID
resources.body: A first Italian tax identification number requires an in-person appointment; eligible applicants apply through the Revenue Agency, while specified non-EU cases are handled by the immigration desk or police headquarters.

resources.title: Florence — Housing
resources.body: As of September 2026, a one-bedroom apartment in Florence city centre averages EUR 1,306 per month; three months is reported as the typical Florence deposit and is also the statutory ceiling; Immobiliare.it carries Florence rental listings.

resources.title: Florence — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity document and an Italian tax code; it accepts a valid health card as the tax-code document.

resources.title: Florence — Schools
resources.body: The International School of Florence offers the International Baccalaureate continuum and an American High School Diploma; the cited directory lists international schools in and near Florence.

resources.title: Florence — Arrival registration
resources.body: New residents should declare residence with the Comune di Firenze Anagrafe; non-Italian residents can use the municipal Immigration Desk for anagraphic procedures and residence-permit support.

resources.title: Florence — Tax ID
resources.body: Italy's tax ID is the codice fiscale.
