Foreigners entering for employed work or family reunification receive it through the Sportello Unico per l'Immigrazione; residence-permit applicants receive it through the Questura. A foreign citizen without one can apply using signed form AA4/8 and the required identity or status document, with an in-person appointment required for a first codice fiscale.

resources.title: Florence — Transport
resources.body: Autolinee Toscane operates Florence's urban network; the ordinary urban-capital monthly pass costs EUR 42.20 and covers Florence metropolitan buses, tramvia and regional trains. Driving-licence rules depend on the issuing country. Eligible EU long-term-residence-permit holders register for Tuscany's Regional Health Service at their local ASL.

resources.title: Genoa — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo's official page says opening its online current account requires a valid identity card, driving licence, or passport plus a valid Italian tax code or health card.

resources.title: Genoa — Schools
resources.body: The International School of Genoa states that it is an IB Continuum School offering the Primary Years Programme, Middle Years Programme, and Diploma Programme; the official IB school finder is provided as the directory.

resources.title: Genoa — Arrival registration
resources.body: A person moving to Genoa from abroad must submit a completed and signed residence declaration to the Comune di Genova within 20 days of moving.

resources.title: Genoa — Tax ID
resources.body: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. Depending on their route, foreign citizens may receive it from an immigration desk or police headquarters; first-time foreign applicants who need the Revenue Agency must attend an in-person appointment with the required identity documentation.

resources.title: Modena — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity document and an Italian tax code; its official page also verifies the bank named here.

resources.title: Modena — Schools
resources.body: International School of Modena states that it offers the IB Primary Years, Middle Years, and Diploma Programmes in English-based international schooling.

resources.title: Modena — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer establishing residence in Modena submits a residence declaration to the Comune; the official guidance requires valid identity documents and proof of the right to occupy the accommodation, with additional documents depending on citizenship.

resources.title: Modena — Tax ID
resources.body: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. Non-EU citizens normally receive it through the immigration desk or Questura during qualifying immigration procedures; EU citizens and other applicants can apply through the Revenue Agency, and a first application by a foreign citizen requires an in-person appointment.

resources.title: Modena — Transport
resources.body: SETA operates the Modena urban service and lists an ordinary monthly Urbano Modena pass at EUR 32. Driving-licence rules come from the Italian transport ministry, and healthcare registration comes from AUSL Modena.

resources.title: Modena — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Eligible newcomers apply to AUSL Modena using the form for their citizenship category; eligible non-EU applicants can submit the form in person or by email with identity document, codice fiscale, and residence-permit evidence, plus condition-specific documents. Source: https://www.ausl.mo.it/modulistica-aziendale/iscrizione-ssn-stranieri-scelta-medico-pediatra/

resources.title: Padua — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that online account applicants provide a valid identity card, driving licence or passport and an Italian tax code, then complete identification by video or bank transfer.

resources.title: Padua — Schools
resources.body: The English International School of Padua states that its high school follows Cambridge IGCSE and then the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme; the official IB directory search returns one Padua match.

resources.title: Padua — Arrival registration
resources.body: Non-EU newcomers establishing residence in Italy for the first time must submit a residence declaration to the Padua municipal registry within 20 days of moving.

resources.title: Padua — Tax ID
resources.body: Foreign citizens obtain the Italian codice fiscale through the Immigration Desk or Questura in specified residence-permit cases, or otherwise from an Italian Revenue Agency office; first-time applicants must attend a booked in-person appointment.

resources.title: Padua — Transport
resources.body: Busitalia Veneto lists the ordinary monthly Padova TU1 urban pass at EUR 42.90. EU or EEA licences generally remain valid until the applicable expiry, while non-EU or non-EEA licences may be used for one year after Italian residence with an international permit or official Italian translation and are convertible only where reciprocity exists. A regular residence-permit holder registers for the SSN through the local ASL for the municipality of registered residence, or the effective domicile shown on the permit if not yet resident.

resources.title: Parma — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity document and an Italian tax code; a valid health card can serve as the tax-code document.

resources.title: Parma — Schools
resources.body: Scuola per l'Europa in Parma is accredited to follow European Schools curricula from nursery through European Baccalaureate level, with Italian, English, and French language sections.

resources.title: Parma — Arrival registration
resources.body: People arriving from abroad who establish their habitual residence in Parma must register it with the municipal registry; applications are submitted through the Comune di Parma online service or with support at the DUC counter.

resources.title: Parma — Tax ID
resources.body: The Italian tax ID is the codice fiscale. Foreign nationals receive it through the Immigration Desk for qualifying entry applications or through the Questura for residence-permit applications; people without one may apply using form AA4/8, with first issuance to foreign nationals requiring an in-person appointment for identification.

resources.title: Parma — Transport
resources.body: TEP S.p.A. operates Parma public transport, and its ordinary personal urban monthly pass costs EUR 39 for a calendar month. Foreign-licence rules depend on the issuing jurisdiction and reciprocity. Eligible newcomers register for the SSN through the CUP office for their Parma health district.

resources.title: Pisa — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports EUR 924.67 monthly for a one-bedroom apartment in Pisa city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Pisa . The University of Pisa says private-rental deposits are generally two or three months and identifies Cerco Alloggio as the DSU lodging-search service: https://www.unipi.it/ateneo/rapporti-internazionali/info-e-servizi-di-accoglienza/alloggi-per-studenti-e-ospiti-internazionali/ .

resources.title: Pisa — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity card, driving licence, or passport plus a valid tax code or health card.

resources.title: Pisa — Schools
resources.body: Westminster International School in Pisa states that it is an IB World School offering the IB Primary Years Programme for ages 3-12. MumAbroad provides a Tuscany and Umbria international-schools directory that includes Pisa schools.

resources.title: Pisa — Arrival registration
resources.body: A foreign citizen never previously resident in Italy can request first anagrafe registration by submitting a residence declaration to the competent municipality through the ANPR residence-change service.

resources.title: Pisa — Tax ID
resources.body: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. First-time EU and non-EU applicants must book an in-person appointment; depending on status it is assigned by the Immigration Single Desk, Questura, or an Italian Revenue Agency office.

resources.title: Pisa — Transport
resources.body: Autolinee Toscane describes Pisa's urban network at https://www.at-bus.it/en/pisa and lists the Pisa-valid Urbano capoluogo monthly pass at EUR 42.20 at https://www.at-bus.it/en/ticket/urban-passes/urbano-capoluogo-monthly-pass . Italy's transport ministry explains licence exchange at https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera . Tuscany's PAeSI portal explains SSN registration at https://www2.immigrazione.regione.toscana.it/?q=risorsepertema&tema=Servizio+Sanitario+Nazionale&temaid=257 .

resources.title: Trieste — Banking
resources.body: For Intesa Sanpaolo XME Conto, a foreign resident needs an Italian tax code; online identification uses an accepted Italian ID document and may require a health card.

resources.title: Trieste — Schools
resources.body: The Trieste directory lists American curriculum at the International School of Trieste and the IB Diploma curriculum at UWC Adriatic.

resources.title: Trieste — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer establishing residence applies for Anagrafe enrolment with the Municipality of Trieste.

resources.title: Trieste — Tax ID
resources.body: Non-Italian citizens obtain a Codice Fiscale by presenting a valid identity document, passport or residence permit at any local Revenue Agency office.

resources.title: Trieste — Transport
resources.body: Trieste urban transport is operated as Trieste Trasporti within Tpl Fvg; the 2026 ordinary monthly whole-network urban pass is EUR 39.20. Driving and healthcare rules are grounded in the official regional sources stated in their fields.

resources.title: Trieste — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Eligible EU newcomers staying over three months and qualifying non-EU permit holders request mandatory or voluntary SSR registration through ASUGI; Trieste health-registry services are by appointment, including at Via Lionello Stock 2. Source URL: https://asugi.sanita.fvg.it/it/servizi/dist_amm_iscriz_ssn_citt_stranieri.html

resources.title: Venice — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that a foreign citizen resident in Italy needs an Italian tax code for its XME account; online identification uses an electronic identity card, passport or driving licence, with a health card when requested.

resources.title: Venice — Schools
resources.body: A Venice schools directory lists IB, British and Cambridge IGCSE curricula among local international schools.

resources.title: Venice — Arrival registration
resources.body: New residents submit a complete residence declaration to the Venice municipal registry; the Ufficio Soggiorno cittadini comunitari handles EU and British registrations and also records habitual-residence declarations and residence permits for non-EU citizens.

resources.title: Venice — Tax ID
resources.body: The Italian tax ID is the codice fiscale. Eligible foreign nationals without one submit signed form AA4/8 and valid identification to a Revenue Agency office; immigration authorities assign it in specified permit processes.

resources.title: Verona — Banking
resources.body: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity card, driving licence, or passport plus an Italian tax code or health card.

resources.title: Verona — Schools
resources.body: The International School of Verona states that its international examinations culminate in the IB Diploma and identifies itself as IB World School 004476.

resources.title: Verona — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer establishing habitual residence in Verona must submit the ministerial Declaration of Residence with the required identity, occupancy, and, for non-Italians, stay-status documents to the Comune di Verona.

resources.title: Verona — Tax ID
resources.body: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. First-time foreign applicants in Italy must book an in-person appointment; depending on status it is assigned by the Immigration Desk, police headquarters, or requested from an Italian Revenue Agency office.

resources.title: Hamamatsu — Banking
resources.body: For online applications, SMBC Trust Bank PRESTIA requires foreign nationals to provide a valid Residence Card or Special Permanent Resident Certificate showing the current address and at least three months remaining; a domestic SMS-enabled phone and email are also required. Applicants in Japan for less than six months must provide evidence of employment in Japan or evidence supporting more than six months of residence.

resources.title: Hamamatsu — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer who enters Japan and establishes an address in Hamamatsu must submit a Moving-In Notification within 14 days at a Ward Municipal Services Division.

resources.title: Hamamatsu — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign newcomer is issued an Individual Number after moving to Japan and registering residence; the Individual Number Notice communicates the number.

resources.title: Amsterdam — Banking
resources.body: ABN AMRO allows eligible newcomers to open an account with an official Dutch home address and a Dutch ID or international passport; a BSN may be supplied within 120 days.

resources.title: Amsterdam — Schools
resources.body: The I amsterdam directory lists international schools in and around Amsterdam and states that many English-language international schools follow International Baccalaureate programmes.

resources.title: Amsterdam — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer staying longer than four months must register with the municipality in the Personal Records Database (BRP) within five days of arrival.

resources.title: Amsterdam — Tax ID
resources.body: The municipality issues the citizen service number (BSN) at BRP registration; short-stay non-residents can receive one through RNI registration, and the BSN is used for tax dealings.

resources.title: Enschede — Banking
resources.body: ABN AMRO's official account-opening page requires an accepted identity document and, for a non-Dutch passport or ID, proof of residence in the Netherlands; a BSN may be supplied within 120 days after opening.

resources.title: Enschede — Schools
resources.body: International School Twente is based in Enschede and states that its established International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme is the final programme students complete before graduation.

resources.title: Enschede — Arrival registration
resources.body: A person moving to Enschede from another country must make an appointment and register in person with the municipality; accompanying family members must also register.

resources.title: Enschede — Tax ID
resources.body: The Dutch Tax Administration identifies the Citizen Service Number (BSN) as the personal government number and says newcomers receive one when they register with a Dutch municipality; people staying under four months can apply at an RNI desk.

resources.title: Leiden — Banking
resources.body: ABN AMRO requires identification, a BSN, proof of a Dutch residential address, and income evidence unless opening only a savings account.

resources.title: Leiden — Schools
resources.body: International School Leiden offers international primary education using the IEYC and IPC curricula.

resources.title: Leiden — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer staying more than four months must register in person with Leiden municipality and schedule the registration within five days of moving.

resources.title: Leiden — Tax ID
resources.body: The Dutch individual tax and government identifier is the Citizen Service Number (BSN), issued when a newcomer registers with a Dutch municipality.

resources.title: Bergen — Banking
resources.body: DNB's official onboarding page says applicants with BankID use a Norwegian national identity number and BankID issued by another Norwegian bank; applicants without BankID submit DNB's form and then identify themselves at a DNB office. DNB's identity page lists accepted valid ID, including a Norwegian or foreign passport. Evidence: https://www.dnb.no/en/personal/customer-service/new-customer-outside-norway.html and https://www.dnb.no/en/help-and-guidance/customer-information

resources.title: Bergen — Schools
resources.body: Bergen Katedralskole officially offers the two-year International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme in Bergen. Norway's public National School Register provides the schools directory. Evidence: https://www.bergenkatedralskole.vgs.no/utdanningsprogram/vare-utdanningsprogram/international-baccalaureate-diploma-programme-/ and https://data.norge.no/en/datasets/975515ce-e225-3f0c-bda7-27111bb9b024/national-school-register-nsr

resources.title: Bergen — Arrival registration
resources.body: UDI states that EU/EEA nationals staying in Norway for more than three months must register under the EU/EEA regulations; non-EU/EEA family members of EU/EEA nationals staying more than three months must apply for a residence card. The police perform EU/EEA registration. Evidence: https://www.udi.no/en/answer-pages/answers-eueea/ and https://www.udi.no/en/word-definitions/registration-certificate-for-eueea-nationals/

resources.title: Bergen — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign employee applies for a tax deduction card. Without an electronic ID or an existing Norwegian identity number, the newcomer books a Tax Administration ID check and brings completed form RF-1209; an employer may alternatively apply for the tax card. A D number cannot be self-applied for: an eligible authority or enterprise requests it when needed. Evidence: https://www.skatteetaten.no/en/forms/tax-deduction-card-for-foreign-citizens and https://www.skatteetaten.no/en/person/national-registry/identitetsnummer-og-elektronisk-id/d-nummer/

resources.title: Bergen — Transport
resources.body: Skyss runs buses and Bergen Light Rail; Bergen is in zone A, and the adult one-zone 30-day ticket costs NOK 700 from 1 May 2026. EU/EEA licences can be exchanged for the corresponding Norwegian category without new tests, while non-EU/EEA exchange eligibility is country-specific. Residents registered in the National Population Register have the right to a GP; most D-number holders do not. Evidence: https://skyss.no/en/tickets-and-prices/prices/bus-light-rail-and--some-boat-connections, https://www.skyss.no/en/tickets-and-prices/prize-zones/, https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchanging-eueea-driving-licences/, https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchange-of-driving-licences-from-countries-outside-the-eueea/, and https://www.helsenorge.no/en/gp/about-gp/the-right-to-a-doctor/

resources.title: Kristiansand — Housing
resources.body: Livingcost.net reports an average city-centre one-bedroom rent of NOK 11,283.75; the Norwegian Consumer Council's tenancy agreement says a deposit/guarantee is normally three months' rent; FINN provides a dedicated Kristiansand rentals portal.

resources.title: Kristiansand — Banking
resources.body: DNB says newcomers need a D-number and must prove their identity with valid identification and supporting documentation at a bank branch; asylum-seeker/refugee alternatives are described for customers without a valid passport.

resources.title: Kristiansand — Schools
resources.body: Kristiansand International School offers the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme for ages 5–10 and Middle Years Programme for ages 11–16; OpenApply provides a school-directory entry.

resources.title: Kristiansand — Arrival registration
resources.body: A foreign national moving to Norway must notify the National Registry. For a stay longer than six months, book an appointment with the Norwegian Tax Administration and submit form RF-1401; recent UDI residence-permit holders generally do not submit the form because UDI notifies the Tax Administration.

resources.title: Kristiansand — Tax ID
resources.body: Norway uses a national identity number or D-number. A person staying at least six months reports the move and undergoes an ID check; if approved, the National Population Register issues a national identity number. A newcomer cannot apply directly for a D-number; an eligible enterprise or authority requests it, and the Tax Administration may request it for taxpayers.

resources.title: Kristiansand — Transport
resources.body: Agder kollektivtrafikk (AKT) runs local and regional bus services. Its temporary adult 30-day Kristiansand-area fare is NOK 647 from 1 May 2026. EU/EEA licences can be exchanged without new tests; non-EU/EEA exchange is limited to the countries listed by Statens vegvesen. Residents registered in the National Population Register are entitled to a GP through the municipal scheme.

resources.title: Oslo — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reported NOK 19,222.90 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Oslo city centre, last updated 26 August 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Oslo. The City of Oslo says the usual security deposit is three months' rent, held in a regulated deposit account: https://www.oslo.kommune.no/english/welcome-to-oslo/accommodation/renting-a-home/. FINN Eiendom is a major local rental portal with an Oslo-specific listings page: https://www.finn.no/realestate/lettings/search.html?location=0.20061.

resources.title: Oslo — Banking
resources.body: DNB's official newcomer guidance says a new arrival needs a D-number, valid identification and supporting documentation presented at a bank office; newcomers must identify themselves at a DNB office: https://www.dnb.no/kundeprogram/bli-kunde/ny-i-norge?la=NO.

resources.title: Oslo — Schools
resources.body: The City of Oslo's international-school directory identifies IB programmes and French- and German-curriculum schools in Oslo: https://www.oslo.kommune.no/english/welcome-to-oslo/children-families/primary-and-secondary-schools-in-oslo/.

resources.title: Oslo — Arrival registration
resources.body: At Oslo's Service Centre for Foreign Workers, EU/EEA citizens intending to stay more than three months book a police appointment for a registration certificate: https://www.sua.no/en/book-appointment/eu-eea/. Non-EU/EEA citizens with a granted residence permit book a police appointment, appear in person, hand in documents, have a photo taken and order a residence card: https://www.sua.no/en/book-appointment/non-eu-eea/.

resources.title: Oslo — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign worker needs a Norwegian identification number (D-number or national identity number) and a tax deduction card. With electronic ID, apply online; without an identification number, book an ID-check appointment and bring completed form RF-1209, or ask the employer to apply: https://www.skatteetaten.no/en/forms/tax-deduction-card-for-foreign-citizens/.

resources.title: Oslo — Transport
resources.body: Ruter is Oslo's public-transport network; its adult 30-day Zone 1 pass costs NOK 655 from 3 May 2026: https://ruter.no/en/nyheter/the-price-of-a-30-day-ticket-for-adults-and-children-will-be-reduced-on-may-3. EU/EEA licences can be exchanged for the corresponding Norwegian category without new tests: https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchanging-eueea-driving-licences/. A non-EU/EEA licence can be exchanged only when its issuing country is listed by the Norwegian Public Roads Administration: https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchange-of-driving-licences-from-countries-outside-the-eueea/. Residents registered in the National Population Register are entitled to a GP; registration and changes are managed through Helsenorge or its guidance service: https://www.helsenorge.no/en/gp/about-gp/the-right-to-a-doctor/.

resources.title: Sandnes — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's June 2026 crowd-sourced Sandnes page reports NOK 12,666.67 monthly for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Sandnes-Norway). The City of Oslo's official newcomer guide states that Norway's usual rental deposit is three months (https://www.oslo.kommune.no/english/welcome-to-oslo/accommodation/renting-a-home/). Norway's official Ny i Norge checklist calls FINN the largest property-listing website (https://www.nyinorge.no/en/arrival/checklist/).

resources.title: Sandnes — Banking
resources.body: DNB's official newcomer guidance says a newcomer needs a Norwegian identity number (national identity number or D-number), valid identification and in-branch identity verification (https://www.dnb.no/kundeprogram/bli-kunde/ny-i-norge?la=NO). DNB's accepted-ID page lists an unexpired Norwegian or foreign passport, Norwegian immigrant passport, Norwegian refugee travel document, Norwegian national ID card, EU/EEA national ID card, qualifying Norwegian driving licence, or photo bank card from another bank (https://www.dnb.no/en/help-and-guidance/customer-information).

resources.title: Sandnes — Schools
resources.body: Sandnes International School states that it offers the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme for ages 6-12 and Middle Years Programme for ages 13-16 (https://sdis.no/international-baccalaureate/). Sandnes municipality provides its local school and school-catchment directory at https://www.sandnes.kommune.no/sti/barn-unge-og-familie/skole/skoler-i-sandnes/.

resources.title: Sandnes — Arrival registration
resources.body: Norway's official newcomer checklist makes the arrival step conditional: EU/EEA citizens staying at least three months must obtain a police registration certificate; non-EU/EEA citizens working or staying over 90 days need a residence permit; anyone staying at least six months must register the move to Norway (https://www.nyinorge.no/en/arrival/checklist/).

resources.title: Sandnes — Tax ID
resources.body: Foreign workers need a tax deduction card and a Norwegian identification number (D-number or national identity number). A newcomer without either number obtains one through the tax-card process by completing RF-1209, booking an ID-check appointment and bringing the form; an employer may alternatively apply for the tax card (https://www.skatteetaten.no/en/forms/tax-deduction-card-for-foreign-citizens).

resources.title: Sandnes — Transport
resources.body: Kolumbus is the local network; Sandnes is a one-zone journey in the Nord-Jæren area (https://www.kolumbus.no/en/help-and-contact/frequently-asked-questions/zones/), and the adult one-zone 30-day ticket costs NOK 791 (https://www.kolumbus.no/en/tickets/-prices-and-products/30-dayticket/). EU/EEA licences can be exchanged without new tests (https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchanging-eueea-driving-licences/); only licences from the listed non-EU/EEA countries can be exchanged (https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchange-of-driving-licences-from-countries-outside-the-eueea/). Residents registered in the National Population Register are entitled to a GP; D-number holders generally are not, except specified groups, but remain entitled to necessary municipal medical treatment (https://www.helsenorge.no/en/gp/about-gp/the-right-to-a-doctor/).

resources.title: Białystok — Banking
resources.body: PKO Bank Polski says a branch applicant should bring an ID card or passport; its account-opening page also lists the personal and contact data requested and says a foreign-country taxpayer should prepare that country's tax identification number.

resources.title: Białystok — Schools
resources.body: II Liceum Ogólnokształcące in Białystok states that its four-year international course combines the final two years of the IB Middle Years Programme with two years of the IB Diploma Programme, with English used for instruction except Polish literature and foreign languages.

resources.title: Białystok — Arrival registration
resources.body: A foreigner living at a Polish address permanently, or temporarily for more than three months, must register that residence with the municipality office where they live; the official service states the applicable deadline can be the 30th day of residence depending on status.

resources.title: Białystok — Tax ID
resources.body: For a natural person who does not conduct business and is not VAT-registered, PESEL is the tax identifier. Other natural persons subject to registration obtain NIP by submitting form NIP-7 to the head of the tax office.

resources.title: Białystok — Transport
resources.body: Białostocka Komunikacja Miejska (BKM) lists a regular named Zone 1 calendar-month pass at 130 PLN in its tariff updated 1 August 2026. Driving-licence and healthcare rules depend on the newcomer's circumstances.

resources.title: Białystok — Healthcare registration
resources.body: An eligible newcomer without another health-insurance entitlement can apply for voluntary NFZ coverage by submitting the required documents to the relevant voivodeship NFZ branch, signing the agreement, and then filing the applicable ZUS forms. https://www.nfz.gov.pl/aktualnosci/aktualnosci-centrali/poradnik-pacjenta-jak-ubezpieczyc-sie-dobrowolnie-sprawdz-to-wazne,8466.html

resources.title: Gdynia — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of PLN 3,155 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Gdynia city centre (source_url: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Gdynia). The usual Polish security deposit is 1-2 months' rent, most often one month (source_url: https://domkaspot.com/blog/rental-deposit-laws-poland-rights-obligations). Otodom has a dedicated Gdynia rental-apartment portal (source_url: https://www.otodom.pl/pl/oferty/wynajem/mieszkanie/gdynia).

resources.title: Gdynia — Banking
resources.body: PKO Bank Polski says an applicant can open an account at a branch with an ID card or passport and lists the required applicant data; a taxpayer of another country should also prepare that country's tax identification number (source_url: https://www.pkobp.pl/en/how-to-open-a-personal-account).

resources.title: Gdynia — Schools
resources.body: Einstein International School in Gdynia states that it is an authorized IB World School offering the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (source_url: https://eisschool.eu/en/home/). The official IB school directory can be searched for the school and country (source_url: https://www.ibo.org/programmes/find-an-ib-school/?SearchFields.Country=PL&SearchFields.Keywords=Einstein%20International%20School).

resources.title: Gdynia — Arrival registration
resources.body: A foreign newcomer living in Poland must register permanent residence or temporary residence exceeding three months at the municipality office where they live, no later than the 30th day of residence at that address (source_url: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/zamelduj-sie-na-pobyt-staly-dla-cudzoziemcow-en).

resources.title: Gdynia — Tax ID
resources.body: For a non-business natural person who has a PESEL and is not VAT-registered or a tax/social-insurance payer, PESEL is the tax identifier and no identification filing is required. A person without PESEL, or one who conducts business, is VAT-registered, or is a tax/social-insurance payer, must submit an identification notification to obtain NIP; natural persons outside CEIDG use NIP-7 (source_url: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/abc-podatkow/rejestracja-podatnikow/).

resources.title: Gdynia — Transport
resources.body: ZKM Gdynia is the city public-transport organizer; its regular personalized monthly ticket for ordinary and night lines in the Gdynia fare zone costs PLN 103 (source_url: https://zkmgdynia.pl/taryfa/bilety-okresowe/). Driving-licence exchange depends on issuing country and residence duration (source_url: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie). A newcomer without another public-insurance basis can obtain voluntary NFZ cover through the regional NFZ branch and then ZUS (source_url: https://www.gov.pl/web/zdrowie/ubezpiecz-sie-dobrowolnie).

resources.title: Gdynia — Healthcare registration
resources.body: If not covered through another public-insurance basis, apply to the regional NFZ branch for voluntary health insurance, sign the contract, then file ZUS ZZA with the local ZUS office within 7 days. Source: https://www.gov.pl/web/zdrowie/ubezpiecz-sie-dobrowolnie

resources.title: Kraków — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reported PLN 3,584.38 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Kraków city centre, last updated 25 August 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Krakow-Cracow. EURES says a Polish rental deposit usually equals one monthly rent: https://eures.europa.eu/living-and-working/living-and-working-conditions-europe/living-and-working-conditions-poland_en. Kraków's official guide for foreigners identifies Otodom and OLX as popular apartment-search sites: https://otwarty.krakow.pl/zalacznik/473210. Live Kraków rental listings are available at https://www.otodom.pl/pl/oferty/wynajem/mieszkanie/krakow.

resources.title: Kraków — Banking
resources.body: PKO Bank Polski's official account-opening page says a branch applicant needs an identity document (ID card or passport). It also lists PESEL, a Polish mobile number, email and residence/mailing addresses among the required data, and a foreign tax identification number when the applicant is a taxpayer of another country: https://www.pkobp.pl/en/how-to-open-a-personal-account.

resources.title: Kraków — Schools
resources.body: The 2026 WhereNext Kraków international-schools directory lists British, International Baccalaureate, Canadian and American curricula among the city's schools: https://getwherenext.com/schools/krakow/insights.

resources.title: Kraków — Arrival registration
resources.body: A foreigner living in Poland must register permanent residence, or temporary residence when staying at an address for more than three months, no later than the 30th day of residence; registration is handled by the municipality office where the person lives: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/zamelduj-sie-na-pobyt-staly-dla-cudzoziemcow-en.

resources.title: Kraków — Tax ID
resources.body: Poland's Ministry of Finance says a foreign national settling tax in Poland should generally use PESEL; NIP applies to people conducting business, registered for VAT or acting as tax or social/health-insurance payers: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/twoj-e-pit/en-pit-36-za-2025-rok. A foreigner receives PESEL automatically after registering residence for over 30 days; if unable to register but an office requires PESEL, apply in person at any municipality office with the legal basis and identity document: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/uzyskaj-numer-pesel--usluga-dla-cudzoziemcow-en.

resources.title: Kraków — Transport
resources.body: The Public Transport Authority organizes Public Transport in Kraków (KMK): https://ztp.krakow.pl/en/kmk-public-transport/kmk-organizer-and-operators. The official tariff effective 2 March 2026 lists a full-fare monthly personalized resident network ticket for zone I at PLN 99: https://ztp.krakow.pl/wszystkie-aktualnosci/kmk/taryfa-biletowa-od-2-marca-wszystkie-dostepne-bilety.html. A valid EU licence remains valid without exchange; otherwise a foreign licence holder living in Poland for at least 185 days should exchange it, and a licence outside the Geneva/Vienna Convention models requires the state theory exam: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie. A resident not covered by mandatory health insurance can apply for voluntary NFZ insurance at the competent regional branch, sign the agreement, then submit ZUS ZZA and, for covered family members, ZUS ZCNA: https://www.nfz.gov.pl/dla-pacjenta/ubezpieczenia-w-nfz/jak-sie-ubezpieczyc-dobrowolnie.

resources.title: Toruń — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of PLN 2,100 for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment in Toruń. Source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Torun Otodom says the usual deposit for a standard dwelling is one month of rent and identifies itself as the most popular Polish property service. Sources: https://www.otodom.pl/wiadomosci/kaucja-za-mieszkanie-wynajem/ https://www.otodom.pl/

resources.title: Toruń — Banking
resources.body: PKO Bank Polski says a branch applicant should bring an ID card or passport. It also lists PESEL, contact and address data, and a foreign tax identification number when applicable. Source: https://www.pkobp.pl/en/how-to-open-a-personal-account

resources.title: Toruń — Schools
resources.body: SOKRATES International Schools in Toruń states that it is approved to offer Cambridge programmes from primary through secondary level. Source: https://sistorun.pl/en/liceum/o-szkole/uprawnienia/ The official Cambridge school directory is https://www.cambridgeinternational.org/why-choose-us/find-a-cambridge-school/?Location=Poland

resources.title: Toruń — Arrival registration
resources.body: A foreign newcomer residing in Toruń registers temporary residence with the Toruń City Office Administrative Affairs Department, in person, electronically, or through an authorised representative, using the registration form, proof of title to the dwelling, and the applicable identity and residence document. Source: https://bip.torun.pl/sprawa-do-zalatwienia/pdf/27363/1

resources.title: Toruń — Tax ID
resources.body: The Ministry of Finance says a foreign employee living in Poland should obtain PESEL by applying to the competent municipal authority with documents confirming the application data; if PESEL is refused, the person may apply for NIP using form NIP-7. Source: https://www.gov.pl/web/finanse/podaj-wlasciwy-pesel-lub-nip-pracownika

resources.title: Toruń — Transport
resources.body: Miejski Zakład Komunikacji w Toruniu (MZK) operates the city network; the standard electronic or City Card monthly ticket for all day and night lines in zone I is PLN 108, while the resident-status price is PLN 98. Sources: https://www.mzk-torun.pl/aktualnosci/6296-zmiany-w-cenniku-biletow-mzk-18-10-2024 https://mzk-torun.pl/aktualnosci/6436-nizsze-ceny-dla-mieszkancow Valid EU/EFTA licences remain valid until expiry; the Polish exchange service is available after at least 185 days of residence. Sources: https://www.gov.pl/web/your-europe/acquiring-and-renewing-a-driving-licence https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie For public healthcare, register an S1 with the NFZ branch for the province of residence; a person without another insurance basis may instead sign a voluntary NFZ agreement and then register with ZUS. Sources: https://www.nfz.gov.pl/dla-pacjenta/medical-treatment-abroad/information-about-treatment-of-persons-from-euefta-member-states-in-poland/ https://www.gov.pl/web/zdrowie/ubezpiecz-sie-dobrowolnie

resources.title: Aveiro — Banking
resources.body: Millennium bcp states that account opening requires account-opening and customer/signature forms, valid identity and taxpayer-number evidence, proof of address, and proof of professional status: https://www.millenniumbcp.pt/ajuda/contas.

resources.title: Aveiro — Arrival registration
resources.body: EU, EEA, Andorran and Swiss nationals staying more than three months must request a registration certificate from their municipality within 30 days after the first three months: https://aima.gov.pt/pt/nacionais-ue-e-familiares/nacionais-ue/certificado-de-registo-para-nacionais-ue. Aveiro municipal customer service handles EU-citizen registration certificates: https://www.cm-aveiro.pt/servicos/gabinete-de-atendimento-integrado.

resources.title: Aveiro — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign national can request a Portuguese NIF in person at any Tax Office or Citizen Shop with prior appointment; a legal representative can request it through the Portal das Finanças e-balcão: https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/apoio_ao_contribuinte/Cidadaos/Dados_pessoais_familia/Dados_pessoais/NIF/Paginas/default.aspx.

resources.title: Aveiro — Transport
resources.body: Aveiro Bus publishes a EUR 15 zone-1 monthly urban pass at https://www.aveirobus.pt/gama-tarifaria. Driving-licence rules depend on the issuing country; qualifying OECD/CPLP licences may remain valid under the listed conditions and optional exchange is available through IMT at https://www.imt-ip.pt/condutores/reconhecimento/troca-de-titulo-de-conducao-estrangeiro/cartas-de-conducao-emitidas-pelos-paises-da-ocde-e-cplp/. Foreign nationals receive an SNS user number on first attending a public health unit, as described at https://www.gov.pt/servicos/pedir-o-numero-de-utente-do-sns, and can register at a local health centre with that number: https://www.gov.pt/servicos/inscrever-se-no-centro-de-saude.

resources.title: Braga — Banking
resources.body: Millennium bcp lists valid identification, a taxpayer number, proof of address and proof of professional status among the documents used to open an account.

resources.title: Braga — Schools
resources.body: The Braga directory lists five international schools and identifies British, American, Portuguese, Hybrid, International and IB Candidate offerings; IB Candidate status is not treated as an authorised IB curriculum.

resources.title: Braga — Arrival registration
resources.body: EU, EEA, Andorran and Swiss nationals staying more than three months and up to five years must request a registration certificate from the city hall for their area of residence within 30 days after the first three months.

resources.title: Braga — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign citizen can request a Portuguese NIF online through e-balcao via a legal representative, or in person by prior appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop.

resources.title: Coimbra — Banking
resources.body: Millennium bcp permits branch account opening and lists accepted identity, taxpayer-number, address, and professional-status evidence on its official account-help page.

resources.title: Coimbra — Arrival registration
resources.body: For EU, EEA, Andorran, and Swiss nationals staying more than three months, AIMA requires a registration certificate from the municipality for the area of residence.

resources.title: Coimbra — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign citizen may request a Portuguese NIF in person by appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop, or online through e-balcao via a legal representative, using identity and foreign-address evidence.

resources.title: Coimbra — Transport
resources.body: Coimbra's SMTUC buses and Metrobus share an intermodal Passe Rede Geral; the reference monthly price is EUR 30 from 1 April 2026.

resources.title: Coimbra — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Eligible foreign residents can obtain the National Health Service user number (NNU) through the integrated identification-number service at participating Citizen Spaces by presenting a passport and activating Chave Movel Digital. Source: https://www.acss.min-saude.pt/2025/03/17/acss-reforca-simplificacao-no-acesso-ao-numero-nacional-de-utente-para-cidadaos-estrangeiros/

resources.title: Faro — Banking
resources.body: Millennium bcp says account applicants need valid identification, a taxpayer number, proof of address from the last 12 months, and proof of professional status from the last 6 months; accepted documents and channels vary by applicant profile.

resources.title: Faro — Schools
resources.body: The Faro-area directory lists Nobel Algarve British International School. Nobel's official page states that its Algarve campuses offer the National Curriculum of England/British curriculum and that Almancil offers the IB Diploma Programme; the campuses shown are in Almancil and Lagoa, not Faro city.

resources.title: Faro — Arrival registration
resources.body: For EU/EEE, Andorran and Swiss nationals staying more than three months, AIMA requires a registration certificate from the municipal council for the area of residence within 30 days after the first three months.

resources.title: Faro — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign citizen may request a NIF online through e-balcão via a legal representative or in person by appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop; identification and proof of foreign address are required.

resources.title: Faro — Transport
resources.body: Próximo is Faro's bus network (https://www.proximo.pt/). Numbeo reports a regular Faro monthly public-transport pass at EUR 37.00 (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Faro?displayCurrency=EUR).

resources.title: Faro — Healthcare registration
resources.body: A foreign national is allocated an SNS user number at the first visit to a public health centre or hospital. For SNS cost coverage, the registration must also include identification, a Portuguese NIF, a full Portuguese address, and a valid residence permit. Source: https://www2.gov.pt/en/servicos/pedir-o-numero-de-utente-do-sns

resources.title: Lisbon — Banking
resources.body: Novo Banco's official account-opening document lists personal identification, tax identification, proof of address, and proof of profession and employer: https://www.novobanco.pt/content/dam/novobancopublicsites/docs/pdfs/abertura-conta/abertura%20conta.pdf.

resources.title: Lisbon — Schools
resources.body: The Lisbon international-schools directory lists IB, British, American, and French curricula: https://www.international-schools-database.com/in/lisbon.

resources.title: Lisbon — Arrival registration
resources.body: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens staying longer than three months must request the EU citizen registration certificate within 30 days after their first three months; Lisbon residents apply to Lisbon City Council and attend in person: https://informacoeseservicos.lisboa.pt/servicos/detalhe/registo-de-cidadao-da-uniao-europeia-certificado.

resources.title: Lisbon — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign citizen can request a Portuguese NIF online through e-balcao via a legal representative or in person by appointment at a Tax Office or Citizen's Shop; the Tax and Customs Authority lists the required documents: https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/en/tax-information/getting-started-in-portugal/tax-identification-number/apply-for-your-nif/Pages/default.aspx.

resources.title: Lisbon — Transport
resources.body: Metropolitano de Lisboa lists the Navegante Metropolitano monthly pass at EUR 40: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/buy/. IMT states that EU/EEA licences remain valid until their stated expiry; rules for other licences depend on issuing country, and convention/reciprocity-country licence holders who become resident can drive for 90 days while applying for exchange, cannot drive on that licence after 90 days, and need a practical test to exchange after two years: https://www.imt-ip.pt/condutores/informacoes-gerais/quero-ser-condutor/tenho-carta-de-conducao-estrangeira/. A foreign national receives an SNS user number at a public health centre or hospital; for SNS cost coverage, the record should include identification, a Portuguese NIF, full Portuguese address, and a valid residence permit: https://www2.gov.pt/en/servicos/pedir-o-numero-de-utente-do-sns.

resources.title: Al Khor — Banking
resources.body: Qatar Islamic Bank's official newcomer page says expatriate applicants need a valid QID, passport copy, employment contract or salary certificate, and residence-address details.

resources.title: Al Khor — Schools
resources.body: Al Khor International School officially offers British Curriculum and India's CBSE pathway; Qatar's Ministry of Education and Higher Education provides the linked private-school directory.

resources.title: Al Khor — Arrival registration
resources.body: For a new residence-permit application, the Ministry of Public Health service requires the applicant to visit the Medical Commission Department as soon as possible after entering Qatar for a medical examination.

resources.title: Al Khor — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who must register for income tax can register through the General Tax Authority's Dhareeba Tax Portal to obtain a Tax Identification Number.

resources.title: Al Wakrah — Banking
resources.body: Commercial Bank of Qatar allows residents or people applying for a residence permit to open a current account by transferring salary.

resources.title: Al Wakrah — Arrival registration
resources.body: New residency-permit applicants must visit the Medical Commission Department as soon as possible after entering Qatar for the required medical examination.

resources.title: Al Wakrah — Tax ID
resources.body: Register through the General Tax Authority's Dhareeba Tax Portal to obtain a Tax Identification Number.

resources.title: Doha — Banking
resources.body: QNB offers digital onboarding to adult Qatar residents with a postpaid Qatari mobile number.

resources.title: Doha — Schools
resources.body: The Ministry of Education and Higher Education private-school search lists multiple curricula available in Qatar.

resources.title: Doha — Arrival registration
resources.body: Applicants seeking a residence permit must visit the Medical Commission Department as soon as possible after entering Qatar for the required medical examination.

resources.title: Doha — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who is a taxpayer because they engage in business activity or earn taxable income registers through the General Tax Authority’s Dhareeba portal to obtain a Tax Identification Number.

resources.title: Riyadh — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports a monthly average of SAR 4,428.68 for a one-bedroom apartment in Riyadh city centre. The official Ejar deposit page says a contract may be documented with no deposit; when one is specified, Ejar registers and holds the amount, so no fixed month norm is stated (https://www.ejar.sa/en/page/181067).

resources.title: Riyadh — Banking
resources.body: Riyad Bank lists the current-account documents for non-Saudis as an Iqama, a clear postal address, and an additional postal address in the home country.

resources.title: Riyadh — Schools
resources.body: The Riyadh international-schools directory lists American, British, IB, and French curriculum schools.

resources.title: Riyadh — Arrival registration
resources.body: After arrival, the residence-registration step is issuance of the resident identity (Iqama) through Absher; the official service covers a family member or domestic worker registered to the beneficiary.

resources.title: Gothenburg — Banking
resources.body: Swedbank's official newcomer checklist requires completed application forms, identity documentation, a Swedish Tax Agency coordination-number extract if assigned, and evidence explaining the account's purpose or source of funds (https://www.swedbank.se/en/private/become-a-customer/become-a-customer-without-mobile-bankid). SEB's official guides require a passport for EU/EEA applicants and a passport plus Swedish residence-permit card for applicants from outside the EU/EEA (https://seb.se/privat/bli-kund/new-in-sweden/eu-and-eea-citizens and https://seb.se/privat/bli-kund/new-in-sweden/outside-eu-and-eea).

resources.title: Gothenburg — Schools
resources.body: The Gothenburg-region schools directory lists ISGR with IB Primary Years and Middle Years programmes and IHGR and Hvitfeldtska with the IB Diploma Programme; it also identifies Swedish national curricula where applicable (https://www.movetogothenburg.com/live/schools-and-preschools/).

resources.title: Gothenburg — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer planning to live in Sweden for at least one year should notify the Swedish Tax Agency through the Moving to Sweden service and, after arrival, attend a booked in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre (https://www.skatteverket.se/movingtosweden).

resources.title: Gothenburg — Tax ID
resources.body: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a Swedish personal identity number when a newcomer is first entered in the Population Register; people staying under one year may instead need a coordination number (https://www.skatteverket.se/movingtosweden and https://www.skatteverket.se/servicelankar/otherlanguages/inenglish/individualsandemployees/livinginsweden/personalidentitynumberandcoordinationnumber.4.2cf1b5cd163796a5c8b4295.html).

resources.title: Gothenburg — Transport
resources.body: Västtrafik is the public-transport network; its current temporary fare page lists a 30-day adult Zone A pass at SEK 445, or SEK 305 for registered Gothenburg residents buying the subsidised ticket in Västtrafik To Go (https://www.vasttrafik.se/biljetter/rabatter/snart-halveras-priset-pa-manadsbiljetter/). The Swedish Transport Agency says valid EEA licences remain valid and may be exchanged by permanent residents, while non-EEA licences generally cease to be valid after one year of Swedish registration and only licences from the UK, Faroe Islands, Switzerland, or Japan may be exchanged under specified conditions (https://www.transportstyrelsen.se/en/road/driving-licences/i-have-a-driving-licence/). Försäkringskassan says newcomers staying at least one year should register with the Swedish Tax Agency; once registered, they receive medical and dental care on the same terms as other residents (https://www.forsakringskassan.se/english/moving-to-working-studying-or-newly-arrived-in-sweden/move-to-sweden).

resources.title: Malmö — Banking
resources.body: A newcomer without Mobile BankID must visit a Nordea branch, identify themselves and explain their banking needs.

resources.title: Malmö — Schools
resources.body: Malmö's municipal international-schools directory lists English-language municipal and independent schools. Malmö International School offers IB PYP and MYP; Malmö Borgarskola offers the IB Diploma; Bladins International School follows IB curricula.

resources.title: Malmö — Arrival registration
resources.body: A person moving to Sweden for one year or more should notify the Swedish Tax Agency through the Moving to Sweden service, then book and attend an in-person identity check at a state service centre with original identity documents.

resources.title: Malmö — Tax ID
resources.body: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a personal identity number when a newcomer is entered in the Swedish Population Register; it is used as the person's identifier with authorities and companies.

resources.title: Malmö — Transport
resources.body: Skånetrafiken is Region Skåne's public-transport operator for city buses, regional buses, Pågatåg and Öresundståg (https://www.skane.se/om-region-skane/kollektivtrafik/). The adult 30-day pass covering all of Skåne costs SEK 685 from 1 July through 31 December 2026 (https://www.svt.se/nyheter/lokalt/skane/priset-pa-manadskort-halveras-i-skane). Driving-licence exchange rules are published by the Swedish Transport Agency (https://www.transportstyrelsen.se/en/road/driving-licences/i-have-a-driving-licence/). Healthcare-centre registration in Skåne is through 1177 e-services or a form (https://vard.skane.se/primarvarden/ditt-besok-hos-oss/valj-oss/).

resources.title: Stockholm — Banking
resources.body: Swedbank says newcomers without Mobile BankID apply at a physical drop-in office, complete its customer-due-diligence and tax-residency forms, prove identity and, depending on status, provide a Swedish Tax Agency register extract and documents explaining account use and finances.

resources.title: Stockholm — Schools
resources.body: The City of Stockholm directory lists international schools at compulsory-school level, and Stockholm International School confirms that it offers the International Baccalaureate continuum through the Diploma Programme.

resources.title: Stockholm — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer who moves to Sweden and plans to live there for at least one year should notify the Swedish Tax Agency to be listed in the Population Register, then book and attend an in-person identity check at a Swedish state service centre.

resources.title: Stockholm — Tax ID
resources.body: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a Swedish personal identity number when a newcomer is first listed in the Swedish Population Register; a person planning to stay less than one year may need a coordination number instead.

resources.title: Stockholm — Transport
resources.body: SL provides public-transport information for Stockholm, and its temporary adult price for a 30-day ticket is SEK 530 for tickets bought no later than 1 December 2026. Driving-licence exchange is governed by the Swedish Transport Agency, while healthcare eligibility for a newcomer follows population registration.

resources.title: Stockholm — Healthcare registration
resources.body: If staying at least one year, register in the Swedish Population Register through the Swedish Tax Agency; once registered, the newcomer is entitled to public medical and dental care on the same terms as other residents. Source: https://www.forsakringskassan.se/english/moving-to-working-studying-or-newly-arrived-in-sweden/move-to-sweden

resources.title: Sundsvall — Banking
resources.body: Swedbank's official newcomer checklist requires an in-person branch visit without Mobile BankID, completed application and tax-residency forms, approved identity documentation, a Skatteverket coordination-number extract if one has been assigned, and supporting evidence of account purpose or finances; a residence permit is required in applicable cases.

resources.title: Sundsvall — Schools
resources.body: Västermalms skola in Sundsvall offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme, taught in English (https://sundsvall.se/kommun/utbildning-och-forskola/gymnasium/sundsvalls-gymnasium/vastermalms-skola/vara-program/international-baccalaureate-diploma-program). Sundsvall municipality's school directory covers municipal and independent compulsory schools.

resources.title: Sundsvall — Arrival registration
resources.body: A newcomer planning to live in Sweden for at least one year generally must notify the Swedish Tax Agency through the Moving to Sweden service, book an appointment, and attend a state service centre for an identity check with original identity documents.

resources.title: Sundsvall — Tax ID
resources.body: The Swedish Tax Agency assigns a Swedish personal identity number when a newcomer is entered in the Population Register. A person staying for less than one year is generally not population-registered and may instead need a coordination number.

resources.title: Sundsvall — Transport
resources.body: Din Tur is the local public-transport network (https://destinationsundsvall.se/english/destination/travel-to-destination-sundsvall). On 31 August 2026, its temporarily subsidised 30-day adult ticket for Sundsvall urban-area travel cost SEK 416.50 (https://www.dintur.se/halva-priset-30-dagar/). EEA licences may be exchanged by valid-licence holders permanently resident in Sweden; among non-EEA licences, only licences from the UK, Faroe Islands, Switzerland or Japan may be exchanged under stated conditions (https://www.transportstyrelsen.se/en/road/driving-licences/i-have-a-driving-licence/). A newcomer staying at least one year generally registers with Skatteverket; once registered in Sweden, the person receives public medical and dental care on the same terms as other residents, while Försäkringskassan's e-service or form 5456 is used when information is needed for benefits, insurance assessment or an EHIC (https://www.forsakringskassan.se/english/moving-to-working-studying-or-newly-arrived-in-sweden/move-to-sweden).

resources.title: Singapore — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports average monthly rent of S$3,820 for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Singapore). A 2026 Singapore rental guide describes the market convention as one month of security deposit per lease year (https://lovelyhomes.com.sg/renting-condo-singapore-guide-2026/). PropertyGuru Group identifies PropertyGuru.com.sg as Singapore's No. 1 property marketplace (https://www.propertygurugroup.com/newsroom/pandemic-uncertainty-spurs-property-ownership-enquiries-from-singaporeans-and-the-need-for-expert-guidance/).

resources.title: Singapore — Banking
resources.body: DBS's official newcomer page says foreign applicants without Singpass upload a passport biodata page (or Malaysian IC), a valid Employment Pass, S Pass, Student's Pass or in-principle approval, proof of residential address, and proof of tax residency (https://www.dbs.com.sg/personal/deposits/for-foreigners/new-to-singapore).

resources.title: Singapore — Schools
resources.body: Singapore American School documents US Common Core and Next Generation Science Standards (https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1728271922/sas/hpccldqjh4xetmvwgcxw/Elementary-School-Program-Guide_2024-25.pdf); Tanglin Trust documents a UK-style English National Curriculum with (I)GCSE and A Level or IB Diploma pathways (https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1742884495/ttsedusg/wsaoq0dblqozufrruybx/AdmissionsPolicy.pdf); UWCSEA documents (I)GCSE followed by the IB Diploma Programme (https://www.uwcsea.edu.sg/curriculum-microhome/what-parents-should-know). The MOE registry can be searched to verify registered private schools (https://www.moe.gov.sg/private-education/private-schools).

resources.title: Singapore — Arrival registration
resources.body: ICA requires travellers, including work-pass and other long-term-pass holders arriving by air or sea, to submit the SG Arrival Card with electronic health declaration within three days including the day of arrival, unless an exemption applies (https://www.ica.gov.sg/enter-transit-depart/entering-singapore/sg-arrival-card).

resources.title: Singapore — Tax ID
resources.body: IRAS identifies an individual's tax reference number as an NRIC or FIN for employee tax services (https://www.iras.gov.sg/digital-services/employees). A foreign individual without a Singapore Government-issued ID who needs digital access for individual or property tax must apply to IRAS for a Singpass Foreign user Account using a national ID or passport, email address, and any existing IRAS tax reference number (https://www.iras.gov.sg/digital-services/others/singpass-foreign-user-account-(sfa)-for-foreign-individuals).

resources.title: Singapore — Transport
resources.body: LTA describes Singapore's public transport system as rail and bus networks (https://www.lta.gov.sg/content/ltagov/en/who_we_are/our_work/public_transport_system.html). SimplyGo prices the Adult Monthly Travel Pass at S$122 for unlimited train and basic bus travel, but eligibility is limited to Singapore citizens and permanent residents (https://simplygo.com.sg/concession-monthly-travel-cards/adult/adult-monthly-travel-card/). Traffic Police says foreigners resident for under 12 months generally need not convert a valid foreign licence; conversion requires a valid foreign licence and passing the Basic Theory Test (https://www.police.gov.sg/Knowledge-Hub/Traffic/Traffic-Matters/Singapore-Driving-Licence). At SingHealth Polyclinics, a new patient makes an appointment and presents original identification such as a work permit at registration (https://polyclinic.singhealth.com.sg/clinic-visit/what-you-need-to-know).

resources.title: Atlanta — Banking
resources.body: Chase's official guidance says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address and an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN if the bank requires a tax number and accepts the substitute.

resources.title: Atlanta — Schools
resources.body: Atlanta International School is authorized for the full International Baccalaureate continuum from 3K through grade 12; Atlanta Public Schools provides a city schools directory by IB programme.

resources.title: Atlanta — Arrival registration
resources.body: The United States has no Atlanta-specific residence registration in the cited source. Most noncitizens must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days after moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt.

resources.title: Atlanta — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who is not eligible for an SSN but needs a U.S. tax-processing number can apply to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and proof of foreign status and identity.

resources.title: Atlanta — Transport
resources.body: MARTA is Atlanta's main cited public-transport network; its standard 30-day pass costs $95.

resources.title: Atlanta — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Eligible newcomers can create a Health Insurance Marketplace account, submit an application to determine eligibility for a Marketplace plan, Medicaid or CHIP, then enroll and pay any required premium. https://www.healthcare.gov/quick-guide/getting-marketplace-health-insurance/

resources.title: Boston — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports an average one-bedroom city-centre rent of USD 3,356.75 per month: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Boston Massachusetts Housing Court says a security deposit may be no more than one month's rent: https://www.mass.gov/info-details/learn-about-paying-a-security-deposit Zillow's Boston rental portal: https://www.zillow.com/boston-ma/rentals/

resources.title: Boston — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America requires eligible non-U.S. professionals to bring proof of foreign and U.S. addresses, two forms of ID, and a tax identification number: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo ID, proof of U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit: https://www.chase.com/personal/banking/education/basics/us-bank-account-for-non-residents

resources.title: Boston — Schools
resources.body: The Boston international-schools directory lists IB, British, French, and American curricula: https://www.international-schools-database.com/in/boston Nord Anglia's official Boston page confirms the National Curriculum for England and IB at British International School of Boston: https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/our-schools/americas/usa/boston

resources.title: Boston — Arrival registration
resources.body: USCIS says noncitizens covered by the rule must report each change of address within 10 days; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt. Reporting can be completed through a USCIS online account or by paper Form AR-11: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange

resources.title: Boston — Tax ID
resources.body: The IRS says foreign individuals should apply for an SSN on Form SS-5 if eligible, or for an ITIN on Form W-7 if they cannot get an SSN; Form W-7 requires identity and foreign-status documentation and generally a federal tax return: https://www.irs.gov/tin/taxpayer-identification-numbers-tin

resources.title: Boston — Transport
resources.body: The MBTA Monthly LinkPass costs USD 90 and covers unlimited subway, local bus, and Silver Line travel through the last day of the month: https://www.mbta.com/fares Massachusetts RMV permits test-free conversion only for licenses from countries with an established arrangement; otherwise a resident must meet identification requirements and take the learner's-permit exam and road test: https://www.mass.gov/how-to/transfer-your-drivers-license-from-a-foreign-country Massachusetts residents can submit the Health Connector eligibility application to be assessed for MassHealth or other coverage and enroll if eligible: https://www.mahealthconnector.org/start

resources.title: Chicago — Banking
resources.body: Chase says non-residents may need official government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN if the bank requires one.

resources.title: Chicago — Schools
resources.body: Chicago's international-school directory lists British, IB, International, German, Montessori, French, and American curricula among 12 English-teaching schools.

resources.title: Chicago — Arrival registration
resources.body: For noncitizens covered by the federal rule, USCIS requires address changes to be reported within 10 days of moving, preferably through a USCIS online account or by paper Form AR-11; the page lists exceptions for A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors.

resources.title: Chicago — Tax ID
resources.body: A foreign individual eligible for an SSN applies with SSA on Form SS-5; a person who cannot obtain an SSN applies to the IRS for an ITIN on Form W-7 with identity and foreign-status evidence, generally attaching a federal tax return unless an exception applies.

resources.title: Chicago — Transport
resources.body: Chicago Transit Authority (CTA) buses and trains use the Ventra fare system; the regular 30-Day CTA/Pace Pass costs USD 75.

resources.title: Chicago — Healthcare registration
resources.body: If eligible for Illinois Medicaid, use the state's ABE portal to check eligibility and submit an application for health-care benefits. https://abe.illinois.gov/access/

resources.title: Dallas — Banking
resources.body: Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN where one is required.

resources.title: Dallas — Schools
resources.body: Dallas International School offers accredited French and U.S. independent-school education and the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme.

resources.title: Dallas — Arrival registration
resources.body: For noncitizens subject to USCIS address reporting, a move must be reported within 10 days, normally through a USCIS online account; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt.

resources.title: Dallas — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an ITIN using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and required identity and foreign-status documentation unless an exception applies.

resources.title: Dallas — Transport
resources.body: Dallas Area Rapid Transit (DART) operates Dallas buses, DART Rail, GoLink and included TRE service; the Local Monthly Pass costs USD 126.

resources.title: Dallas — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Public coverage is eligibility-based, not automatic. Apply for Texas benefits through Your Texas Benefits and submit requested proof, which may include identity, Texas residence, income, and immigration status. Source: https://www.hhs.texas.gov/services/questions-about-your-benefits/benefits-application-next-steps

resources.title: Houston — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America requires eligible international professionals to provide foreign and U.S. addresses, primary and secondary identification, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. TIN or ITIN is required only if already issued. Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit, with exact requirements varying by bank.

resources.title: Houston — Schools
resources.body: Houston offers International Baccalaureate and French Baccalaureate curricula at the Awty International School. Houston Independent School District publishes a city schools directory.

resources.title: Houston — Arrival registration
resources.body: CBP creates electronic I-94 arrival/departure records for foreign visitors, who can retrieve the record online when proof of status is needed. After moving, aliens in the United States must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days, except A and G visa holders and Visa Waiver Program visitors.

resources.title: Houston — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer eligible for a Social Security number can apply online and then present documents at a Social Security office. A resident or nonresident alien with a federal tax purpose who is not eligible for an SSN applies to the IRS for an ITIN using the ITIN application process, generally with the tax return.

resources.title: Los Angeles — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's city ranking lists a 1-bedroom city-centre rent of USD 2,613.76 per month. California Civil Code section 1950.5 caps most residential security deposits at one month's rent, with a qualifying small-landlord exception up to two months. Zillow provides a Los Angeles rentals portal. Deposit source: https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=1950.5. Portal source: https://www.zillow.com/los-angeles-ca/rentals/

resources.title: Los Angeles — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America's official international-professional page says eligible non-U.S. citizens opening in person need proof of foreign and U.S. addresses, one primary and one secondary ID, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. TIN or ITIN is needed only if one has been issued.

resources.title: Los Angeles — Schools
resources.body: The International School of Los Angeles offers International Baccalaureate programs and the French national curriculum. The California Association of Independent Schools member directory lists the school. Directory source: https://www.caisca.org/schools

resources.title: Los Angeles — Arrival registration
resources.body: Most noncitizens in the United States must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days of moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt. The change can be submitted through a USCIS online account or by mailing Form AR-11.

resources.title: Los Angeles — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a U.S. taxpayer identification number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an ITIN by completing Form W-7, generally attaching a federal income-tax return, and providing supporting documents proving foreign status and identity.

resources.title: Los Angeles — Transport
resources.body: LA Metro's EZ Transit base pass includes all Metro services and costs USD 110 per month. Transit source: https://www.metro.net/fares/ez-transit-pass/ California DMV requires holders of a foreign driver licence to follow the standard original-licence application process and also pass a driving test. Driving source: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/driver-licenses-identification-cards/driver-licenses-dl/ Medi-Cal is California's public Medicaid program for eligible residents; applications can be made online, by phone, by mail, or at a county office. Healthcare source: https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal/pages/applyformedi-cal.aspx

resources.title: Miami — Banking
resources.body: Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit; requirements vary and should be confirmed with the bank.

resources.title: Miami — Schools
resources.body: Miami-Dade County Public Schools lists International Baccalaureate and Cambridge International programs, and its Magnet Schools directory can be searched by international and advanced-studies themes.

resources.title: Miami — Arrival registration
resources.body: Miami has no separate city residence-registration step in the opened sources. Federally, most noncitizens, except A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors, must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days of moving.

resources.title: Miami — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a U.S. tax-processing number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply for an ITIN by completing Form W-7, generally attaching a federal tax return, and providing identity and foreign-status documents.

resources.title: Miami — Transport
resources.body: Miami-Dade Transit operates Metrobus and Metrorail with a USD 112.50 one-month pass. Florida may require holders of foreign-country licences to complete state licensing requirements. Eligible newcomers can apply for Marketplace health coverage online.

resources.title: Miami — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Apply and enroll in Marketplace health coverage through HealthCare.gov; U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, and eligible lawfully present immigrants can obtain Marketplace coverage. Sources: https://www.healthcare.gov/apply-and-enroll/how-to-apply/ and https://www.healthcare.gov/immigrants/

resources.title: Nashville — Housing
resources.body: August 2026 average monthly rent for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre is USD 1,932.44. Rent source https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Nashville | Tennessee deposit practice is typically one to two months of rent. Deposit source https://riooapp.com/blog/tennessee-security-deposit-laws | A major Nashville rental-listings portal is Rent.com. Portal source https://www.rent.com/tennessee/nashville-apartments

resources.title: Nashville — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America says eligible non-U.S. citizens opening in person need proof of both foreign and U.S. addresses, two IDs, and a tax identification number. Official bank source https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account

resources.title: Nashville — Schools
resources.body: Metro Nashville Public Schools offers International Baccalaureate and Cambridge International programs. Curricula source https://www.mnps.org/experience | Tennessee's official approved nonpublic-schools directory can be used to verify private-school approval. Directory source https://www.tn.gov/education/families/school-options/non-public-schools.html

resources.title: Nashville — Arrival registration
resources.body: There is no Nashville municipal residence-registration step identified. At the federal level, most noncitizens must report a U.S. address change to USCIS within 10 days of moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are excluded. Authority source https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange

resources.title: Nashville — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who is not eligible for a Social Security number and needs a U.S. federal tax number can apply to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and supporting identity and foreign-status documents. Authority source https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/how-to-apply-for-an-itin

resources.title: Nashville — Transport
resources.body: Nashville's network is WeGo Public Transit; adult local service is capped at USD 65 for a full calendar month. Fare source https://www.wegotransit.com/buy/fare-information/ | New residents from other countries must take vision, knowledge, and road-skills tests for a Tennessee licence and may retain their foreign licence. Licence source https://www.tn.gov/safety/driver-services/classd/dlnew.html | Eligible residents can apply for Tennessee's public Medicaid program, TennCare, online through TennCare Connect, by phone, or by paper. Healthcare source https://www.tn.gov/tenncare/members-applicants/how-do-i-apply-for-tenncare.html

resources.title: New York — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's 1 September 2026 contributor dataset lists a city-centre one-bedroom average of USD 4,368.58; NYC HPD limits a security deposit to one month's rent; StreetEasy's official support identifies it as part of the NYC Rental Network. Rent source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/New-York?displayCurrency=USD Deposit source: https://www.nyc.gov/site/hpd/services-and-information/tenant-bill-of-rights.page Portal source: https://support.streeteasy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360062042051-How-does-the-NYC-Rental-Network-work

resources.title: New York — Banking
