resources.body: Bank of America says an eligible international professional opening in person needs foreign and U.S. addresses, one primary and one secondary ID, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. SSN is not required.

resources.title: New York — Schools
resources.body: New York City has international options offering the International Baccalaureate and English National Curriculum, including IGCSE and A Level pathways at the British International School of New York. NYC Public Schools' MySchools page is an official searchable school directory.

resources.title: New York — Arrival registration
resources.body: After moving, most noncitizens in the United States must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are excepted. USCIS recommends its online change-of-address tool, while Form AR-11 may be mailed.

resources.title: New York — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a U.S. federal tax number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an ITIN using Form W-7, normally with a federal income-tax return and documents proving foreign status and identity.

resources.title: New York — Transport
resources.body: MTA New York City Transit runs the subway and bus network. It no longer sells a 30-day unlimited MetroCard; OMNY instead caps subway and local-bus fares at USD 35 per rolling 7 days. New York DMV does not exchange licences issued outside the U.S. or Canada. Eligible newcomers can apply for Medicaid or other coverage through NY State of Health. Fare/pass source: https://www.mta.info/fares-tolls/2025-changes Driver source: https://dmv.ny.gov/driver-license/drivers-from-other-countries Healthcare source: https://info.nystateofhealth.ny.gov/enrollment

resources.title: Philadelphia — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 1,971.19 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Philadelphia city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Philadelphia Pennsylvania law caps a first-year residential security deposit at two months of rent and one month in later years: https://www.legis.state.pa.us/WU01/LI/LI/US/HTM/1951/0/0020.005.000..HTM Zillow provides the Philadelphia rentals portal: https://www.zillow.com/philadelphia-pa/rentals/

resources.title: Philadelphia — Banking
resources.body: Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address and possibly an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN where accepted: https://www.chase.com/personal/banking/education/basics/us-bank-account-for-non-residents

resources.title: Philadelphia — Schools
resources.body: William W. Bodine High School in Philadelphia offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme: https://bodine.philasd.org/international-baccalaureate-program/ The School District of Philadelphia online directory searches schools by name, location number or ZIP code: https://apps1.philasd.org/onlinedirectory/

resources.title: Philadelphia — Arrival registration
resources.body: The United States has no Philadelphia-specific residence registration in the cited source. Noncitizens subject to USCIS address reporting must report a change of address within 10 days; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt: https://www.uscis.gov/ar-11

resources.title: Philadelphia — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who is not eligible for an SSN but needs a U.S. tax-processing number can apply to the IRS for an ITIN using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and proof of foreign status and identity: https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/how-to-apply-for-an-itin

resources.title: Philadelphia — Transport
resources.body: The Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority (SEPTA) is the main public-transport network; its Monthly TransPass+ costs USD 116: https://wwww.septa.org/fares/

resources.title: Philadelphia — Healthcare registration
resources.body: Public coverage is eligibility-based, not automatic. Apply for Pennsylvania Medicaid, called Medical Assistance, online through COMPASS or through a County Assistance Office, by phone or by mail; identity, income, residency and citizenship or lawful-status documentation may be required. https://www.pa.gov/services/dhs/apply-for-medicaid-benefits

resources.title: Phoenix — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America says an international professional opening an account in person needs a foreign and U.S. address, two forms of identification, and a foreign tax identification number; an SSN is not required unless issued.

resources.title: Phoenix — Schools
resources.body: International Baccalaureate curriculum is available at North High School in Phoenix; the linked GreatSchools Phoenix directory lists city schools.

resources.title: Phoenix — Arrival registration
resources.body: Noncitizens subject to the federal alien address-reporting rule must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days of moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt.

resources.title: Phoenix — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer eligible for an SSN applies on Form SS-5; a person who cannot obtain an SSN but needs a U.S. tax-processing number applies to the IRS for an ITIN on Form W-7 with identity and foreign-status documentation and generally a federal tax return.

resources.title: Phoenix — Transport
resources.body: Valley Metro is the regional public-transport network. Smart Fare replaces an upfront monthly pass with pay-as-you-go fare capping; the full-fare local bus and light-rail monthly maximum is USD 64.

resources.title: Phoenix — Healthcare registration
resources.body: There is no automatic universal public-healthcare registration. Eligible Arizona residents can apply for AHCCCS Medical Assistance online through Health-e-Arizona Plus or use the application routes listed by AHCCCS. https://azahcccs.gov/Members/GetCovered/apply.html

resources.title: San Diego — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's 1 September 2026 user-contributed estimate is USD 3,344.71 monthly for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/San-Diego?displayCurrency=USD . For most California residential rentals, the security-deposit cap is one month's rent: https://oag.ca.gov/tenants . Zillow is a San Diego rental-search portal: https://www.zillow.com/san-diego-ca/apartments/

resources.title: San Diego — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America's official newcomer page requires a foreign address, proof of a U.S. physical address, one primary and one secondary ID, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. TIN/ITIN is needed only if already issued: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account

resources.title: San Diego — Schools
resources.body: San Diego High School documents an International Baccalaureate curriculum and Diploma Programme: https://sdhs.sandiegounified.org/academics/international_baccalaureate_program . The San Diego County Office of Education School Finder is the regional directory for districts, public and charter schools, and educational programs: https://www.sdcoe.net/schools/finder

resources.title: San Diego — Arrival registration
resources.body: No San Diego municipal residence-registration step was found. At the federal level, noncitizens in the United States generally must report each address change to USCIS within 10 days, except A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors; USCIS recommends its online account and also accepts Form AR-11 by mail: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange

resources.title: San Diego — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a U.S. federal taxpayer ID and is ineligible for a Social Security number applies to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number with Form W-7; the IRS says not to file W-7 while eligible for or awaiting an SSN, and generally requires an SSA denial letter when SSA finds the applicant ineligible: https://www.irs.gov/instructions/iw7

resources.title: San Diego — Transport
resources.body: San Diego Metropolitan Transit System (MTS) operates MTS Bus, Trolley and Rapid services; the Regional Adult Month Pass is USD 72: https://www.sdmts.com/fares/fare-chart . California DMV says visitors 18+ may drive on a valid home-country licence, but California residents must obtain a California licence within 10 days and complete the DMV application/testing process: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/file/fast-facts-5-requirements-for-a-california-drivers-license/ . Eligible newcomers can apply for California's public Medi-Cal coverage through Covered California, or through a county office, by phone or by mail: https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal-resources/medi-cal-eligibility-division/apply-for-medi-cal-or-other-affordable-quality-health-coverage/

resources.title: San Francisco (Bay Area) — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo's city ranking lists a 1-bedroom city-centre rent of USD 3,811.67 per month. California Civil Code section 1950.5 caps most residential security deposits at one month's rent, with a qualifying small-landlord exception up to two months. Zillow provides a San Francisco rentals portal. Deposit source: https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=CIV&sectionNum=1950.5. Portal source: https://www.zillow.com/san-francisco-ca/rentals/

resources.title: San Francisco (Bay Area) — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America's official international-professional page says eligible non-U.S. citizens opening in person need proof of foreign and U.S. addresses, one primary and one secondary ID, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. TIN or ITIN is needed only if one has been issued.

resources.title: San Francisco (Bay Area) — Schools
resources.body: The International School of San Francisco offers French bilingual immersion, the International Baccalaureate, and French Baccalaureate pathways. The California Association of Independent Schools member directory lists the school. Directory source: https://www.caisca.org/schools

resources.title: San Francisco (Bay Area) — Arrival registration
resources.body: Most noncitizens in the United States must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days of moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt. The change can be submitted through a USCIS online account or by mailing Form AR-11.

resources.title: San Francisco (Bay Area) — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a U.S. taxpayer identification number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an ITIN by completing Form W-7, generally attaching a federal income-tax return, and providing supporting documents proving foreign status and identity.

resources.title: San Francisco (Bay Area) — Transport
resources.body: SFMTA's Muni-only adult monthly pass provides unlimited Muni rides, including cable cars, for USD 86. Transit source: https://www.sfmta.com/fares/monthly-adult-ages-19-64 California DMV requires holders of a foreign driver license to follow the standard original-license application process and also pass a driving test. Driving source: https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/driver-licenses-identification-cards/driver-licenses-dl/ Medi-Cal is California's public Medicaid program for eligible residents; applications can be made online, by phone, by mail, or at a county office. Healthcare source: https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/medi-cal/pages/applyformedi-cal.aspx

resources.title: Seattle — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America's official international-professional page requires a physical U.S. address, proof of foreign and U.S. addresses, two forms of identification, and a foreign tax identification number; accepted primary ID includes a foreign passport: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account.

resources.title: Seattle — Schools
resources.body: Seattle Public Schools offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme and Career-related Programme and lists the Seattle schools offering each: https://www.seattleschools.org/departments/high-school-college-career/advanced-level-and-alternative-courses/ib/.

resources.title: Seattle — Arrival registration
resources.body: Most noncitizens must report a change of U.S. address to USCIS within 10 days of moving, using the online change-of-address tool or paper Form AR-11; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange.

resources.title: Seattle — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer with a federal tax purpose who is not eligible for a Social Security number applies to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number; the IRS says to apply by mail or in person with an ITIN application package: https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/individual-taxpayer-identification-number-itin.

resources.title: Seattle — Transport
resources.body: King County Metro is Seattle's principal bus network; its current adult USD 3 fare corresponds to a USD 108 monthly PugetPass: https://kingcounty.gov/en/dept/metro/fares-and-payment/prices. New Washington residents must obtain a state licence within 30 days: https://dol.wa.gov/moving-washington/get-driver-license. Adults with valid licences from listed reciprocal jurisdictions avoid tests, while licences from unlisted countries or Canadian provinces require the first-licence process: https://dol.wa.gov/pa/node/254. Newcomers can apply online or through a navigator via Washington Healthplanfinder, which screens for Apple Health (Medicaid) and other programs subject to immigration-status and income eligibility: https://wahealthplanfinder.org/us/en/health-coverage/who-can-sign-up/immigrants.html.

resources.title: Washington DC — Housing
resources.body: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 2,634 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre. DC guidance says a security deposit may not exceed one month's rent. DCHousingSearch.org is the District's free affordable-housing rental listing and search engine. Sources: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Washington https://dds.dc.gov/page/h-whate-are-10-steps-tenancy https://www.dchousingsearch.org/index.html

resources.title: Washington DC — Banking
resources.body: Bank of America states that eligible non-US-citizen international professionals with a physical US address open in person and provide foreign and US addresses, two IDs, and a foreign tax identification number; a US TIN/ITIN is required only if already issued. Source: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account

resources.title: Washington DC — Schools
resources.body: Washington International School in Washington, DC offers French or Spanish language immersion/dual-language study and enrolls all grades 11-12 students in the IB Diploma Programme. My School DC's School Finder searches District schools by address, grade, and program type. Sources: https://www.wis.edu/ https://www.myschooldc.org/node/29536

resources.title: Washington DC — Arrival registration
resources.body: No general DC municipal residence-registration step was identified. Federally, most noncitizens must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days of moving using the online account tool or paper Form AR-11; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt. Source: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange

resources.title: Washington DC — Tax ID
resources.body: A newcomer who needs a US taxpayer identification number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number by submitting Form W-7, a federal income tax return unless an exception applies, and supporting identity/foreign-status documents, by mail or through an authorized in-person option. Source: https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/how-to-apply-for-an-itin

resources.title: Washington DC — Transport
resources.body: WMATA operates Metro Rail and Metro Bus; Monthly Unlimited Passes cost USD 72-216 depending on fare level. A non-US citizen residing in DC more than 30 days and not on a visitor visa must obtain a DC license; a valid foreign-license holder must pass the knowledge test but not the road-skills test and may keep the foreign license. DC has no universal public-healthcare registration; eligible District residents may apply for MAGI Medicaid through District Direct, while non-MAGI applicants use the Integrated Application for Medical Assistance. Sources: https://www.wmata.com/pay/pay-passes.html https://dmv.dc.gov/service/driver-license-for-non-us-citizens https://dhcf.dc.gov/service/how-qualify-dc-medicaid https://districtdirect.dc.gov/ua/
